name: Asian Stir-Fry
desc: Quick and flavorful Asian-style stir-fry recipes with vegetables, proteins, and savory sauces.

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 500 g (1 lb) beef sirloin, thinly sliced
Sauce: 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, 1 tbsp brown sugar, ½ cup beef broth
recipes.prep: Marinate beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp cornstarch for 15 minutes. Mix remaining sauce ingredients. Blanch broccoli 2 minutes. Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Cook beef in batches until browned. Remove. Stir-fry garlic and ginger 30 seconds. Add broccoli, return beef, pour sauce, toss until thickened. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken Teriyaki Stir-Fry
recipes.prep: Mix soy sauce, mirin, and sugar for sauce. Heat oil in wok, cook chicken until golden. Add vegetables and stir-fry 2–3 minutes. Pour sauce, cook until slightly thickened. Serve hot with rice.

recipes.name: Shrimp and Snow Pea Stir-Fry
ingredients: 400 g (14 oz) shrimp, peeled and deveined
recipes.prep: Heat oil in wok. Stir-fry garlic 30 seconds. Add shrimp, cook until pink. Add snow peas and soy sauce, stir-fry 2 minutes. Drizzle sesame oil and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Tofu and Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.prep: Heat oil in wok, cook tofu until golden. Remove. Stir-fry vegetables 3–4 minutes. Return tofu, add soy sauce and hoisin sauce. Toss to combine and serve.

recipes.name: Pork and Bok Choy Stir-Fry
recipes.prep: Heat oil in wok. Stir-fry garlic and ginger 30 seconds. Add pork, cook until browned. Add bok choy and soy sauce, cook 2–3 minutes until tender-crisp. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Beef and Snow Pea Stir-Fry
ingredients: 400 g beef flank steak, thinly sliced
recipes.prep: Toss beef with cornstarch. Heat oil in wok, stir-fry beef until browned. Add garlic, cook 30 seconds. Add snow peas and sauces, stir-fry 2–3 minutes. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Cashew Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.prep: Heat oil, stir-fry chicken until cooked. Add bell pepper and cook 2 minutes. Stir in soy sauce, hoisin sauce, and cashews. Toss until coated and serve.

recipes.name: Ginger Beef Stir-Fry
recipes.prep: Heat oil in wok. Stir-fry garlic and ginger 30 seconds. Add beef, cook until browned. Add bell pepper, soy sauce, and rice vinegar. Stir-fry 2–3 minutes and serve hot.

recipes.name: Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.prep: Heat oil in wok. Stir-fry vegetables 3–4 minutes until tender-crisp. Add soy sauce and sesame oil, toss, and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Spicy Szechuan Stir-Fry
recipes.prep: Heat oil in wok. Stir-fry chicken until cooked. Add bell peppers and cook 2–3 minutes. Stir in soy sauce, chili garlic sauce, and sesame oil. Toss until coated and serve hot.

name: Lamb
desc: Roasted leg of lamb, lamb chops, slow-cooked shanks, kebabs, and lamb dishes from around the world.

recipes.name: Braised Lamb Shanks
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C). Season shanks and brown on all sides in olive oil in a Dutch oven. Remove. Cook vegetables until softened. Add garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute. Add wine and reduce. Add broth, tomatoes, and herbs. Return shanks. Cover and braise 2.5–3 hours until meat is falling off the bone. Remove shanks. Strain and reduce sauce. Return shanks to sauce.

recipes.name: Greek Lamb Gyros
ingredients: 600 g (1.3 lbs) ground or sliced lamb
Marinade: 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp oregano, salt and pepper
Pita, tzatziki, tomatoes, onion, and fries to serve
recipes.prep: Mix marinade. Coat lamb thoroughly. For ground lamb shape into flat oblong patties. For sliced lamb, marinate 2 hours. Cook in a hot pan or on a grill until cooked through and slightly charred. For authentic texture, stack and slice thinly. Serve in warm pita with tzatziki, diced tomatoes, red onion, and fries.

recipes.name: Lamb Biriyani
ingredients: 1 onion, thinly sliced and fried crispy
Spices: 2 tsp biryani masala, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, ½ tsp turmeric, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves
Fried onions and ghee to finish
recipes.prep: Marinate lamb in yogurt, garlic, ginger, and spices 2 hours. Cook marinated lamb until tender 45 minutes. Cook rice until 70% done. Layer lamb and rice in a heavy pot with saffron milk, mint, cilantro, and fried onions between layers. Seal pot with dough or tight foil. Cook on very low heat 30 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before opening. Gently mix layers and serve.

recipes.name: Lamb Chops
ingredients: Mint sauce or tzatziki to serve
recipes.prep: Mix olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, rosemary, and thyme. Coat lamb chops and marinate at least 1 hour. Remove from fridge 30 minutes before cooking. Heat a grill pan or skillet over very high heat. Season chops with salt and pepper. Sear 3–4 minutes per side for medium rare or 4–5 minutes for medium. Rest 5 minutes. Serve with mint sauce or tzatziki.

recipes.name: Lamb Curry
recipes.prep: Heat oil in a large pot. Cook onion until golden. Add garlic and ginger and cook 2 minutes. Add all spices and cook 1 minute. Add lamb and brown on all sides. Add crushed tomatoes. Cover and simmer 45 minutes. Add coconut milk and simmer 15 more minutes until lamb is tender and sauce is rich. Adjust seasoning. Garnish with cilantro. Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.name: Lamb Kebabs
recipes.prep: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Shape onto flat metal skewers into long sausage shapes, pressing firmly. Grill over high heat or in a grill pan, turning every 2–3 minutes until cooked through and slightly charred — about 10–12 minutes. Serve in warm flatbread with tzatziki and fresh salad.

recipes.name: Lamb Kofta
recipes.prep: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Shape into oval patties or balls. Cook on a hot grill or in a skillet over medium-high heat 3–4 minutes per side until cooked through and nicely browned. Serve with warm pita, tzatziki, fresh tomatoes, and cucumber.

recipes.name: Lamb Rogan Josh
recipes.prep: Heat oil in a heavy pot. Cook onion until deeply golden — about 15 minutes. Add garlic and ginger and cook 2 minutes. Add all spices and cook 1 minute. Add lamb and brown on all sides. Add yogurt a spoon at a time, stirring between each addition. Add crushed tomatoes. Cover and simmer 1–1.5 hours until lamb is very tender. Adjust seasoning. Serve with basmati rice and naan.

recipes.name: Lamb Souvlaki
ingredients: 600 g (1.3 lbs) lamb leg or shoulder, cubed
Marinade: 4 tbsp olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp cumin, salt and pepper
Pita, tzatziki, onion, and tomatoes to serve
recipes.prep: Mix marinade and coat lamb. Marinate at least 2 hours. Thread onto skewers. Grill over high heat turning occasionally 10–12 minutes until cooked through with nice char. Serve in warm pita with tzatziki, sliced onion, and tomatoes.

recipes.name: Lamb Stew
recipes.prep: Brown lamb in olive oil in a large pot in batches. Remove. Cook onion, carrots, and garlic until softened. Add tomato paste and wine and reduce. Add broth and herbs. Return lamb. Simmer covered 1 hour. Add potatoes and cook 30 more minutes until everything is very tender. Adjust seasoning.

recipes.name: Lamb Tagine
ingredients: Cilantro and toasted almonds to garnish
recipes.prep: Heat olive oil in a tagine or Dutch oven. Brown lamb on all sides. Remove. Cook onion until golden. Add garlic and spices and cook 1 minute. Return lamb. Add tomatoes, broth, apricots, and olives. Cover and simmer over low heat 1.5–2 hours until lamb is very tender. Adjust seasoning. Garnish with cilantro and toasted almonds. Serve with couscous.

recipes.name: Moussaka
ingredients: Béchamel: 4 tbsp butter, ¼ cup flour, 2 cups milk, 2 eggs, ½ cup Parmesan, nutmeg
recipes.prep: Salt eggplant slices and rest 30 minutes. Pat dry and grill or fry until golden. Make meat sauce: brown lamb with onion and garlic. Add wine, tomatoes, cinnamon, and allspice. Simmer 20 minutes. Make béchamel. Preheat oven to 375°F. Layer in a baking dish: eggplant, meat sauce, eggplant, then pour béchamel over top. Bake 45 minutes until golden. Rest 15 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Rack of Lamb
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Season racks generously with salt and pepper. Sear fat side down in olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over high heat until golden — about 3 minutes. Flip and sear 1 minute more. Mix mustard with garlic. Brush over the fat cap. Mix breadcrumbs with rosemary, parsley, and olive oil. Press herb crust firmly onto mustard. Roast 20–25 minutes for medium rare. Rest 10 minutes. Slice between bones.

recipes.name: Roasted Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 2 kg (4.5 lbs) bone-in leg of lamb
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Make deep incisions all over lamb and push garlic slices in. Mix olive oil, lemon juice, and herbs and rub all over lamb. Season generously with salt and pepper. Place in a roasting pan. Roast at high heat 20 minutes to brown. Reduce to 350°F. Add wine and broth to pan. Roast 1–1.5 hours for medium, basting occasionally. Internal temperature should reach 135°F for medium. Rest 20 minutes before carving.

recipes.name: Slow Roasted Lamb Shoulder
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C). Make deep incisions and push garlic in. Rub all over with olive oil, oregano, cumin, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Sear in oven at high heat 20 minutes until browned. Reduce to 325°F. Add wine and broth to pan. Cover tightly with foil. Roast 4–5 hours until meat falls away from the bone. Shred with forks. Serve with pan juices.

name: Minced Meat Dishes
desc: Burgers, meatballs, meat sauces, stuffed dishes, and recipes using ground beef, pork, turkey, or lamb.

recipes.name: Arancini
ingredients: 3 cups leftover risotto or freshly made and cooled
recipes.prep: Cook ground beef with peas and season. Cool. With wet hands take a handful of risotto and flatten. Place a cube of mozzarella and a spoonful of meat filling in the center. Close the risotto around the filling forming a ball. Roll in flour, dip in egg, coat in breadcrumbs. Deep fry at 350°F for 4–5 minutes until golden all over. Drain on paper towels. Serve with marinara sauce.

recipes.name: Banh Mi Meatball Sub
ingredients: Quick pickled daikon and carrots: julienned, soaked in rice vinegar, sugar, salt 30 minutes
Jalapeño, cilantro, cucumber, and sriracha mayo
recipes.prep: Mix pork with garlic, fish sauce, and sugar. Form into small meatballs. Pan fry until cooked through and browned. Slice baguettes and spread with sriracha mayo. Fill with meatballs. Top generously with pickled daikon and carrots, sliced jalapeño, fresh cilantro, and cucumber slices.

recipes.name: Classic Cheeseburger
ingredients: Toppings: lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, mustard, ketchup, mayo
recipes.prep: Divide beef into 4 equal portions. Shape gently into patties slightly wider than the bun — they will shrink. Make a small indent in the center. Season both sides generously with salt and pepper just before cooking. Heat a cast iron skillet or grill over very high heat. Cook patties without pressing 3–4 minutes until crust forms. Flip once. Add cheese. Cook 2–3 more minutes for medium. Rest 2 minutes. Build burgers and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Cottage Pie
ingredients: Mashed potato topping: 1 kg potatoes, 4 tbsp butter, ½ cup cream, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Brown beef and drain. Cook vegetables until soft. Add garlic and tomato paste. Add broth and Worcestershire. Simmer 20 minutes. Add peas. Pour into a baking dish. Make mashed potatoes and spread over top. Rough up surface with a fork. Bake at 375°F 25–30 minutes until top is golden.

recipes.name: Dolmades Stuffed Grape Leaves
ingredients: Filling: 300 g (10.5 oz) ground lamb or beef, 1 cup rice, 1 onion grated, ¼ cup fresh mint, ¼ cup fresh dill, juice of 1 lemon, salt and pepper
Plain yogurt and lemon to serve
recipes.prep: Mix filling ingredients together. Place a teaspoon of filling at the stem end of each grape leaf. Fold sides in and roll up tightly. Line a heavy pot with any torn leaves. Arrange rolls seam side down. Add broth and olive oil. Place a plate on top to keep them submerged. Simmer covered over low heat 45–50 minutes until rice is cooked. Serve warm or at room temperature with yogurt and lemon.

recipes.name: Empanadas
ingredients: Dough: 2 cups flour, 6 tbsp butter, 1 egg, ¼ cup cold water, 1 tsp salt
Filling: 300 g (10.5 oz) ground beef, 1 onion diced, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, ½ cup green olives, 2 hard boiled eggs chopped, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Make dough and refrigerate 30 minutes. Brown beef with onion and garlic. Add spices, olives, and hard boiled eggs. Cool. Roll dough thin and cut into circles. Fill each circle with a spoonful of filling. Fold over and crimp edges firmly with a fork. Brush with egg wash. Bake at 400°F 20–25 minutes until golden. Can also be deep fried.

recipes.name: Gyoza Dumplings
ingredients: 2 cups napa cabbage, finely chopped and squeezed dry
Dipping sauce: soy sauce, rice vinegar, chili oil
recipes.prep: Mix all filling ingredients together. Place a teaspoon of filling on each wrapper. Fold and pleat to seal. Heat a thin layer of oil in a flat skillet over medium-high heat. Add gyoza flat side down. Cook until bottoms are golden — about 3 minutes. Add ¼ cup water, cover immediately, and steam 5 minutes. Uncover and cook until water evaporates and bottoms are crispy again. Serve with dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Homemade Meatballs
ingredients: ½ cup breadcrumbs soaked in ¼ cup milk
recipes.prep: Mix all ingredients gently until just combined — do not overwork or meatballs will be tough. Roll into golf ball sized balls with wet hands. Brown in olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat on all sides. Do not crowd. Finish in marinara sauce simmering 15–20 minutes until cooked through. Alternatively bake at 400°F for 18–20 minutes.

recipes.name: Kofta Curry
ingredients: Kofta: 500 g (1 lb) ground lamb or beef, 1 onion grated, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, salt and pepper
Curry sauce: 1 onion diced, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp ginger, 1 can crushed tomatoes, 1 cup yogurt, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp turmeric, 2 tbsp oil
recipes.prep: Mix kofta ingredients and shape into small ovals or balls. Brown in oil and remove. Make curry sauce by cooking onion golden, adding garlic, ginger, and spices. Add tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes. Blend until smooth. Return to pan. Stir in yogurt. Add kofta and simmer 15 minutes. Serve with basmati rice and naan.

recipes.name: Meatball Soup
ingredients: Meatballs: 400 g (14 oz) ground beef, ¼ cup breadcrumbs, 1 egg, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp Parmesan, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Mix meatball ingredients and roll into small balls. Bring broth to a simmer. Add onion, carrots, celery, and garlic and cook 10 minutes. Drop meatballs directly into simmering broth. Cook 10 minutes. Add pasta and cook until tender. Stir in spinach and cook until wilted. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Picadillo
ingredients: Rice and fried plantains to serve
recipes.prep: Brown beef in olive oil. Add onion and garlic and cook until softened. Add cumin, cinnamon, and bay leaf. Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes. Add olives, raisins, and capers. Simmer 10 more minutes until thick and fragrant. Season with salt and pepper. Remove bay leaf. Serve over white rice with fried sweet plantains.

recipes.name: Shepherd's Pie
recipes.prep: Brown lamb with onion, carrots, and celery. Add garlic, tomato paste, broth, Worcestershire, rosemary, and thyme. Simmer 20 minutes until thick. Add peas. Pour into a baking dish. Top with creamy mashed potatoes. Rough up with a fork. Bake at 375°F 25–30 minutes until golden on top.

recipes.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut tops off peppers and remove seeds. Brown beef with onion and garlic. Add tomatoes, rice, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Fill peppers with meat mixture. Place in a baking dish with ¼ cup water. Cover and bake 30 minutes. Uncover, top with mozzarella, and bake 15 more minutes.

recipes.name: Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 500 g (1 lb) ground beef and pork mixed
½ cup breadcrumbs soaked in ¼ cup milk
Gravy: 3 tbsp butter, 3 tbsp flour, 2 cups beef broth, ½ cup sour cream
Lingonberry jam and egg noodles to serve
recipes.prep: Mix meats with soaked breadcrumbs, egg, onion, allspice, nutmeg, salt and pepper. Roll into small balls about 1 inch. Brown in butter in batches. Remove. Make gravy in same pan — melt butter, whisk in flour, add broth gradually until smooth and thick. Stir in sour cream. Return meatballs. Simmer 10 minutes. Serve over egg noodles with lingonberry jam.

name: Grilled Meats
desc: Steaks, chops, skewers and whole fish from the grill.

recipes.name: Carne Asada
ingredients: 1 kg (2 lbs) skirt steak or flap meat
Marinade: juice of 3 limes and 2 oranges, 4 garlic cloves, ½ cup cilantro, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder, salt and pepper
Corn tortillas, salsa, guacamole, and cilantro to serve
recipes.prep: Mix marinade. Marinate steak at least 2 hours, ideally overnight. Remove from fridge 30 minutes before grilling. Grill over very high heat 3–4 minutes per side until charred on the outside but still medium rare inside. Rest 5 minutes. Slice very thinly against the grain. Serve on warm corn tortillas with salsa, guacamole, diced onion, and cilantro.

recipes.name: Grilled Lamb Chops
recipes.prep: Mix olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, zest, rosemary, and thyme. Coat lamb chops. Marinate at least 1 hour. Remove from fridge 30 minutes before grilling. Season with salt and pepper. Grill over very high heat 3 minutes per side for medium rare. Rest 5 minutes. Serve with fresh mint chimichurri.

recipes.name: Grilled Octopus
ingredients: Lemon, capers, and fresh parsley for finishing
recipes.prep: Simmer octopus in water with lemon, garlic, thyme, and bay leaf until tender — about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Cool in cooking liquid. Remove octopus and pat completely dry. Brush with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Grill over very high heat 3–4 minutes per side until charred and slightly crispy. Slice tentacles. Drizzle with good olive oil, lemon juice, capers, and fresh parsley.

recipes.name: Grilled Pork Belly Skewers
ingredients: 700 g (1.5 lbs) pork belly, cut into cubes
Marinade: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp ginger, ½ tsp five spice
Sesame seeds and green onions to garnish
recipes.prep: Mix marinade and coat pork belly cubes thoroughly. Marinate at least 2 hours. Thread onto skewers. Grill over medium heat turning frequently about 15–20 minutes until cooked through and caramelized on all sides, brushing with reserved marinade during cooking. The fat should render slightly and edges should be sticky and charred. Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onions.

recipes.name: Grilled Swordfish Steaks
ingredients: Salsa verde or chimichurri to serve
recipes.prep: Mix olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano. Coat swordfish and marinate 30 minutes — no longer or acid will start to cook the fish. Remove from marinade. Season with salt and pepper. Grill over high heat 4 minutes per side until firm and cooked through with nice grill marks. Swordfish should be cooked through but still moist — do not overcook. Serve with salsa verde.

recipes.name: Grilled T-Bone Steak
ingredients: Coarse salt and freshly cracked black pepper
recipes.prep: Bring steaks to room temperature 45 minutes before cooking. Pat dry. Rub with olive oil and season very generously with coarse salt and cracked pepper on all sides. Grill over very high direct heat 3–4 minutes per side until deep grill marks form. Move to indirect heat if needed to finish. Internal temperature should be 130°F for medium rare. Rest 8–10 minutes. Top with compound butter made from softened butter, garlic, and rosemary.

recipes.name: Grilled Whole Fish
ingredients: 2 whole sea bass or branzino, cleaned
Fresh herbs — thyme, rosemary, and parsley
recipes.prep: Score fish on both sides 3–4 times. Season inside and out with salt and pepper. Stuff cavity with lemon slices, fresh herbs, and garlic. Drizzle with olive oil. Oil grill grates thoroughly. Grill over medium-high heat without moving 5–6 minutes until skin releases naturally and is charred and crispy. Flip carefully. Grill 4–5 more minutes until cooked through. Serve with extra lemon.

recipes.name: Jerk Chicken
ingredients: Jerk marinade: 4 scotch bonnet peppers, 6 green onions, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp allspice, 1 tsp cinnamon, ½ tsp nutmeg, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, juice of 1 lime, 3 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Blend all marinade ingredients until smooth. Score chicken pieces deeply. Coat thoroughly with marinade. Marinate overnight. Grill over indirect medium heat 35–40 minutes turning occasionally. Move to direct heat for last 5–10 minutes to char slightly and caramelize. Internal temperature should reach 165°F. Rest 5 minutes. Serve with rice and peas and fried plantains.

recipes.name: Mixed Grill Platter
ingredients: Tzatziki, hummus, and hot sauce to serve
recipes.prep: Marinate and season each protein appropriately. Grill items in order of cooking time — chicken first, lamb chops, sausages, and kofta last. Grill tomatoes and peppers alongside. Warm flatbread on the grill. Arrange everything on a large platter. Serve family style with tzatziki, hummus, and hot sauce.

name: Sausages
desc: Brats, chorizo, kielbasa and sausage dishes.

recipes.name: Beer Braised Brats
ingredients: 2 bottles (24 oz) beer — lager or pilsner
Hoagie rolls and mustard to serve
recipes.prep: Melt butter in a large skillet. Cook onions and garlic over medium heat until golden and caramelized — about 15 minutes. Add bratwurst and pour beer over. Bring to a simmer. Cook uncovered 20 minutes until brats are cooked through. Remove brats and grill or sear in a hot pan 2–3 minutes per side until browned and slightly charred. Serve on hoagie rolls with caramelized onions and mustard.

recipes.name: Chorizo and Eggs
ingredients: 200 g (7 oz) fresh Mexican chorizo, casings removed
Warm tortillas and salsa to serve
recipes.prep: Cook chorizo in a skillet over medium heat breaking it up until browned and fat is rendered. Drain excess fat if desired. Add onion, jalapeño, and garlic and cook until softened. Add tomatoes and cook 2 minutes. Whisk eggs and pour over chorizo mixture. Scramble gently over medium-low heat until eggs are just set. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with warm tortillas and fresh salsa.

recipes.name: Chorizo Paella
recipes.prep: Heat olive oil in a large paella pan. Brown chicken and chorizo. Remove. Cook onion, pepper, and garlic. Add tomatoes and paprika. Add rice and stir to coat. Add warm saffron broth. Return chicken and chorizo. Cook uncovered without stirring 18–20 minutes until rice is cooked and has formed a crust on the bottom. Rest 5 minutes. Garnish with parsley and lemon.

recipes.name: Hot Dog Bar
ingredients: Condiments: mustard, ketchup, relish, sauerkraut, diced onion, jalapeños, cheddar sauce, chili, coleslaw
recipes.prep: Grill hot dogs over medium-high heat turning frequently until nicely charred and skin blisters slightly — about 5–6 minutes. Alternatively boil in water or steam. Toast buns on the grill or in a skillet with a little butter. Set up a condiment bar and let everyone build their own. Classic combinations: Chicago style with mustard, relish, onion, and tomato; New York style with sauerkraut and spicy mustard; chili cheese dog.

recipes.name: Kielbasa and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) beer or chicken broth
Mashed potatoes or crusty bread to serve
recipes.prep: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook onion until caramelized — about 15 minutes. Add garlic and caraway seeds and cook 1 minute. Add sauerkraut, beer, and brown sugar. Stir well. Add sliced kielbasa. Cover and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Uncover and cook until liquid mostly evaporates. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with mashed potatoes.

recipes.name: Sausage and Lentil Stew
ingredients: 400 g (14 oz) smoked sausage or kielbasa, sliced
1 cup (190 g) green or brown lentils
recipes.prep: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Cook sausage slices until browned. Remove. Cook onion, carrots, and celery until softened. Add garlic, cumin, and paprika and cook 1 minute. Add lentils, broth, and tomatoes. Simmer 25–30 minutes until lentils are tender. Return sausage. Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with fresh parsley.

recipes.name: Sausage Rolls
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Mix sausage meat with onion, garlic, mustard, egg yolk, thyme, salt, and pepper. Cut pastry sheets in half lengthwise. Place a log of sausage meat along one edge of each strip. Roll up tightly. Press to seal with egg wash. Cut into portions. Brush with egg wash and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake 20–25 minutes until golden and cooked through.

recipes.name: Sausage Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 large cremini mushrooms, stems removed and chopped
300 g (10.5 oz) Italian sausage, casings removed
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Cook sausage in a skillet breaking it up. Add onion, garlic, and chopped mushroom stems and cook until softened. Cool slightly. Mix with cream cheese, Parmesan, and parsley. Season. Brush mushroom caps with olive oil inside and out. Fill generously with sausage mixture. Bake 20–25 minutes until mushrooms are tender and tops are golden. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Toad in the Hole
ingredients: Yorkshire pudding batter: 1 cup (120 g) flour, 3 eggs, 1 cup (240 ml) milk, pinch of salt
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Make batter by whisking flour, eggs, milk, and salt until smooth. Rest 30 minutes. Pour oil into a large roasting pan and heat in oven until smoking hot. Add sausages and cook 10 minutes until browned. Quickly pour batter over and around sausages. Return to oven immediately without opening for 25–30 minutes until batter is puffed and deeply golden. Do not open the oven while it bakes. Serve with onion gravy.

recipes.name: Italian Sausage and Peppers
ingredients: 600 g (1.3 lbs) Italian sausages, sweet or hot
3 bell peppers, sliced — red, yellow, green
½ cup (120 ml) dry white wine
Hoagie rolls or pasta to serve
recipes.prep: Brown sausages in olive oil over medium-high heat on all sides. Remove and slice into pieces. Cook peppers and onions in the same pan until softened and slightly caramelized. Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Add wine and cook 2 minutes. Add diced tomatoes and sausage. Simmer 15 minutes until sauce thickens. Add fresh basil. Serve on hoagie rolls or over pasta.

recipes.name: Bratwurst with Beer and Onions
ingredients: Hoagie buns, sauerkraut, and mustard to serve
recipes.prep: Melt butter in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook onions slowly 15 minutes until golden. Add garlic and caraway seeds and cook 1 minute. Add beer and bring to a simmer. Add bratwurst. Simmer covered 20 minutes turning once. Remove bratwurst and grill or pan fry over high heat 3–4 minutes until nicely browned and skin is crispy. Continue reducing the beer onion mixture until thick. Serve brats on buns with beer onions, sauerkraut, and mustard.

recipes.name: Chorizo and Potato Hash
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) Mexican or Spanish chorizo
Fresh cilantro and hot sauce to serve
recipes.prep: Cook potatoes in salted boiling water 5 minutes. Drain. Cook chorizo in a large skillet over medium-high heat breaking it up until browned. Remove. Cook onion and pepper in chorizo fat until soft. Add garlic and cumin 1 minute. Add potatoes and cook undisturbed 5 minutes until crispy. Return chorizo and toss. Create 4 wells in the hash. Crack an egg into each well. Cover and cook on medium-low heat until eggs are set to your liking. Garnish with cilantro.

recipes.name: Italian Sausage Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) Italian sausage, casings removed
½ cup (120 ml) dry red wine
recipes.prep: Cook pasta until al dente. Brown sausage in olive oil over medium-high heat breaking it up. Remove. Cook onion in same pan until soft. Add garlic, oregano, and red pepper flakes 1 minute. Add wine and reduce. Add crushed tomatoes. Return sausage. Simmer 20 minutes. Toss with drained pasta. Top with Parmesan and fresh basil.

recipes.name: Andouille and Red Bean Stew
ingredients: 2 cans (14 oz each) red kidney beans, drained
Steamed white rice and green onions
recipes.prep: Cook andouille in a large pot until browned. Remove. Cook onion, celery, and pepper in sausage drippings until soft. Add garlic and Cajun seasoning and cook 1 minute. Return andouille. Add broth, diced tomatoes, beans, and thyme. Bring to a boil. Reduce and simmer 30 minutes until stew thickens. Mash some beans against the side of the pot for a creamier texture. Season with salt and pepper. Serve over white rice with green onions.

recipes.name: Chorizo Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) Mexican chorizo, casings removed
Toppings: diced white onion, fresh cilantro, avocado, salsa verde, lime wedges, queso fresco
recipes.prep: Cook chorizo in a dry skillet over medium-high heat breaking it up until fully cooked and slightly crispy — about 8–10 minutes. Drain excess fat. Warm tortillas directly over a gas flame or in a dry skillet until lightly charred. Fill each with chorizo. Top with diced onion, cilantro, avocado, and a spoonful of salsa verde. Crumble queso fresco over top. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.name: German Sausage Platter
ingredients: Pretzels and dark bread to serve
recipes.prep: Cook onions in butter over medium heat 20 minutes until caramelized. Add sauerkraut, beer, and caraway seeds. Simmer 15 minutes. Grill or pan fry all sausages over medium-high heat turning frequently until browned and cooked through. Arrange sausages on a platter over a bed of beer-braised sauerkraut and onions. Serve with whole grain mustard, pretzels, and dark bread.

recipes.name: Breakfast Sausage Patties
recipes.prep: Mix ground pork with all seasonings and maple syrup if using. Mix well but do not overwork. Form into thin patties about 3 inches wide. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Cook patties 3–4 minutes per side until deeply golden and cooked through to 160°F (71°C). Do not press down — let them cook undisturbed for best browning. Rest 2 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Spicy Chorizo Pizza
ingredients: ½ lb (225 g) Spanish chorizo, thinly sliced
Fresh arugula and Parmesan to top after baking
Red pepper flakes and olive oil
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 500°F (260°C) with a pizza stone or inverted baking sheet inside. Stretch dough to desired shape. Spread thin layer of crushed tomatoes. Top with mozzarella, chorizo, red onion, and roasted red peppers. Drizzle with olive oil. Bake 10–12 minutes until crust is charred and crispy and cheese is bubbling. Top immediately with fresh arugula and shaved Parmesan.

name: Cured Meats
desc: Prosciutto, salami, guanciale and other cured meats.

recipes.name: Carbonara with Guanciale
ingredients: 4 large egg yolks plus 1 whole egg
100 g (3.5 oz) Pecorino Romano, finely grated
recipes.prep: Cook pasta until al dente. While pasta cooks render guanciale in a skillet over medium heat until crispy and fat is fully rendered. Remove from heat. Whisk egg yolks, whole egg, and both cheeses with generous black pepper. Reserve 1 cup pasta water. Drain pasta. Add to skillet with guanciale off the heat. Add egg mixture and toss vigorously while adding pasta water a splash at a time until sauce is creamy and silky. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Mortadella Sandwich
recipes.prep: Split the bread and drizzle the inside generously with olive oil. Spread olive tapenade or pesto on one half. Layer mozzarella slices on the bottom half. Fold mortadella slices and layer generously over mozzarella. Top with a handful of fresh arugula. Crack black pepper over everything. Close the sandwich and press gently. Slice and serve. Toasting the bread lightly first is optional but excellent.

recipes.name: Nduja Pasta
ingredients: ½ cup (120 ml) dry white wine
recipes.prep: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add nduja and cook, breaking it up, until fat renders and it turns deep red — about 3 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Add wine and cook 1 minute. Add crushed tomatoes. Simmer 15 minutes. Cook pasta until al dente. Toss with sauce adding pasta water as needed. Finish with Parmesan and fresh basil.

recipes.name: Prosciutto Wrapped Chicken
ingredients: ½ cup (120 ml) dry white wine
recipes.prep: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Place 2 sage leaves on each breast. Wrap tightly with 2 slices of prosciutto. Heat olive oil and butter in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear wrapped chicken 3 minutes per side until prosciutto is golden. Transfer to 400°F oven and cook 15–18 minutes until cooked through. Remove chicken. Deglaze pan with wine and broth. Reduce to make a pan sauce. Serve chicken with pan sauce.

recipes.name: Prosciutto Wrapped Melon
ingredients: 1 cantaloupe melon, peeled and sliced into wedges
recipes.prep: Wrap each melon wedge with a slice of prosciutto, folding it neatly around the melon. Arrange on a platter. Tuck fresh basil leaves between pieces. Crack black pepper generously over the top. Drizzle with a little extra virgin olive oil and balsamic glaze if desired. Serve immediately as an appetizer — the contrast of sweet melon and salty prosciutto is the entire dish.

recipes.name: Salami Pizza
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 500°F (260°C) with a pizza stone or heavy baking sheet inside for at least 30 minutes. Stretch dough thin. Spread sauce leaving a border. Layer mozzarella. Add salami slices. Season with red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper. Slide onto hot stone or baking sheet. Bake 8–12 minutes until crust is deeply golden and cheese is bubbly with brown spots. Top with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Pork
desc: Chops, ribs, roasts, shoulder, belly, bacon and more.

subcategories.name: Belly
subcategories.desc: Crispy, braised and burnt-end pork belly.

recipes.name: Braised Pork Belly Bao
ingredients: 500 g (1 lb) pork belly, cut into thick slices
Braising liquid: 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp dark soy sauce, 3 tbsp sugar, ½ cup Shaoxing wine, 2 cups water, star anise, cinnamon
Pickled cucumber, hoisin sauce, and green onions
recipes.prep: Blanch pork belly 5 minutes. Drain. Brown in a pan on all sides. Add all braising liquid ingredients. Braise covered over low heat 1.5–2 hours until pork is very tender and sauce has thickened to a glaze. Cool and slice. Reheat in braising liquid. Steam bao buns. Fill each bun with a slice of pork belly, pickled cucumber, hoisin sauce, and green onions.

recipes.name: Pork Belly
ingredients: 1 kg (2 lbs) pork belly, skin on
Glaze: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp hoisin, 2 garlic cloves
Star anise and five spice for braising
recipes.prep: Score pork skin deeply. Mix salt and baking powder and rub into skin. Refrigerate uncovered overnight. Braise pork belly skin side down in broth with star anise and five spice at 325°F for 2 hours. Remove and cool completely. Brush flesh side with glaze. Roast at 425°F for 20 minutes skin side up. Switch to broil for 5–10 minutes until skin blisters and crackles. Rest 10 minutes and slice.

recipes.name: Pork Belly Burnt Ends
ingredients: 3 lbs (1.4 kg) skinless pork belly, cut into 1½-inch cubes
Dry Rub: 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp black pepper
recipes.prep: Toss pork belly cubes with dry rub. Smoke at 250°F (120°C) for 3 hours until bark forms. Transfer to a disposable aluminum pan. Add BBQ sauce, honey, and butter. Cover tightly with foil. Return to smoker or oven at 250°F (120°C) for 1.5–2 hours. Uncover and cook 30 more minutes until sauce reduces and caramelizes and burnt ends are sticky and deeply glazed.

recipes.name: Pork Belly Ramen
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) pork belly, whole piece
Chashu Marinade: 4 tbsp soy sauce, 3 tbsp mirin, 2 tbsp sake, 2 tbsp sugar, 3 garlic cloves, 2 green onions
Broth: 6 cups chicken broth, 4 tbsp white miso, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil
Soft boiled eggs, nori, corn, bamboo shoots, green onions
recipes.prep: Roll pork belly and tie with twine. Brown in a pan. Place in a zip bag or container with chashu marinade. Sous vide at 167°F (75°C) for 12 hours or braise covered in oven at 275°F (135°C) for 3 hours. Cool and refrigerate. Slice and pan-fry until caramelized. Make broth by combining chicken broth, miso, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Cook noodles. Build ramen bowls with noodles, hot broth, chashu slices, soft boiled eggs, and toppings.

recipes.name: Pork Belly Bao Buns
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) pork belly, sliced into 1-inch thick slabs
Marinade: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp hoisin, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp honey, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp five spice
Quick pickled cucumbers: cucumber sliced, rice vinegar, sugar, salt
Hoisin sauce, sriracha, cilantro, and green onions
recipes.prep: Marinate pork belly at least 2 hours. Cook in a 375°F (190°C) oven for 30 minutes basting with marinade twice. Slice. Heat bao buns by steaming 2 minutes. Open each bun and fill with glazed pork belly slices, pickled cucumber, hoisin sauce, sriracha, cilantro, and green onions.

recipes.name: Lechon Kawali
ingredients: 2 lbs (900 g) pork belly, skin on
Lechon sauce or vinegar dipping sauce to serve
recipes.prep: Simmer pork belly in water with salt, bay leaf, peppercorns, and garlic for 45–60 minutes until just tender. Remove and cool completely — refrigerate overnight uncovered to completely dry the skin. Cut into serving portions. Deep fry in oil at 375°F (190°C) for 8–10 minutes until skin blisters and crackles into perfect chicharrón and pork is deep golden. Drain on a wire rack. Serve with lechon sauce.

recipes.name: Chicharrones
ingredients: 2 lbs (900 g) pork skin, cut into 3-inch squares
Lime juice and hot sauce to serve
recipes.prep: Simmer pork skin in salted water 1 hour until soft. Drain and dry completely. Season with salt and baking powder — the baking powder helps puffing. Refrigerate uncovered overnight to completely dry. Deep fry small batches in oil at 400°F (200°C) for 3–5 minutes until they puff dramatically and are very crispy. Drain immediately. Season with salt. Squeeze lime juice over. Serve with hot sauce. They deflate quickly so serve immediately.

recipes.name: Dong Po Rou (Red Braised Pork Belly)
ingredients: 2 lbs (900 g) pork belly, cut into 2-inch squares
¼ cup (60 ml) dark soy sauce
recipes.prep: Blanch pork belly 5 minutes. Drain and rinse. Place in a clay pot or Dutch oven skin side down. Add all remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce to the lowest heat. Cover and braise 1.5–2 hours turning once until pork is incredibly tender and sauce is thick and glossy. The pork belly should be meltingly soft and deeply soy-caramel flavored. Serve over steamed rice.

subcategories.name: Chops
subcategories.desc: Chops, cutlets and schnitzel.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Apple
recipes.prep: Season pork chops with salt and pepper. Sear in butter in a large oven-safe skillet over high heat 3 minutes per side until golden. Remove. Cook apples and onions in the same pan until softened. Add garlic and thyme. Add cider and broth. Return chops to pan. Transfer to 375°F oven and cook 12–15 minutes until internal temperature reaches 145°F. Rest 5 minutes. Serve with apple onion mixture and pan juices.

recipes.name: Pork Schnitzel
ingredients: 4 pork loin cutlets, pounded very thin
4 tbsp butter and 2 tbsp oil for frying
Lemon wedges and parsley to serve
recipes.prep: Pound cutlets very thin. Season flour with salt, pepper, and paprika. Dredge cutlets in seasoned flour, dip in egg, coat in breadcrumbs. Heat butter and oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Fry schnitzels 2–3 minutes per side until golden. Do not press down — allow them to float in the fat for crispier results. Drain on paper towels. Serve immediately with lemon wedges and fresh parsley.

recipes.name: Tonkatsu
ingredients: 4 pork loin cutlets, about 1.5 cm thick
Tonkatsu sauce, shredded cabbage, and steamed rice to serve
recipes.prep: Pound pork cutlets to even thickness. Score edges to prevent curling. Season with salt and pepper. Dredge in flour, dip in egg, coat in panko pressing firmly. Shallow fry in 1 cm of oil at 340°F about 3–4 minutes per side until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack. Slice into strips. Serve over shredded cabbage with tonkatsu sauce and steamed rice.

recipes.name: Pan-Seared Pork Chops
recipes.prep: Remove pork chops from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking. Pat completely dry with paper towels. Season generously on all sides with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a cast iron skillet over high heat until smoking. Place chops and sear without moving 4 minutes until a deep golden crust forms. Flip. Add butter, garlic, and herbs. Baste continuously with foaming butter 3–4 minutes. Internal temperature should reach 145°F (63°C). Rest 5 minutes before serving — the center will still be slightly pink which is perfectly safe and desirable.

recipes.name: Smothered Pork Chops
recipes.prep: Season pork chops with salt and pepper. Dredge in flour shaking off excess. Sear in hot oil in a skillet 3–4 minutes per side until golden. Remove. Cook onions in butter in same pan over medium heat 15 minutes until deeply caramelized. Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Sprinkle remaining flour over onions and stir 1 minute. Add broth and scrape up browned bits. Add cream and thyme. Return pork chops. Cover and simmer on low heat 20 minutes until very tender and gravy is thick.

recipes.name: Grilled Pork Chops with Apple Glaze
ingredients: Apple Glaze: 1 cup apple cider, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tsp fresh thyme
Dry Rub: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Mix dry rub and coat pork chops. Refrigerate 1 hour. Make glaze by simmering all glaze ingredients in a small saucepan until reduced by half and slightly syrupy. Brush chops with olive oil. Grill over medium-high heat 4–5 minutes per side. Brush generously with apple glaze in the last 2 minutes of cooking on each side. Internal temperature should reach 145°F (63°C). Rest 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Stuffed Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 thick-cut bone-in pork chops, 1½ inch thick
Stuffing: 1 cup breadcrumbs, ½ cup Parmesan, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp fresh sage, 2 tbsp fresh parsley, 2 tbsp butter, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Cut a deep pocket into each pork chop through the side. Mix stuffing ingredients together. Fill each pocket generously. Secure with toothpicks. Season outside with salt and pepper. Sear in hot olive oil in an oven-safe skillet 3 minutes per side until golden. Add broth to pan. Transfer to oven at 375°F (190°C) and bake 20–25 minutes until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C). Rest 5 minutes. Remove toothpicks before serving.

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Pork Chops
ingredients: Sauce: 4 tbsp honey, 4 garlic cloves minced, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tsp red pepper flakes
recipes.prep: Season pork chops with salt and pepper. Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chops 4–5 minutes per side until cooked through and golden. Remove and rest. In same pan mix honey, garlic, soy sauce, and vinegar. Cook 2 minutes until slightly thickened. Return chops and coat in sauce for 1 minute per side. Garnish with parsley. Serve with sauce spooned over.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Mushroom Sauce
recipes.prep: Season and sear pork chops in hot oil 4 minutes per side until golden. Remove. Cook mushrooms in butter over high heat until golden — about 5 minutes. Add shallots and garlic and cook 2 minutes. Add wine and reduce. Add cream and thyme. Simmer until thickened. Return pork chops and simmer on low 10 minutes until cooked through. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Cherry Sauce
ingredients: Cherry Sauce: 2 cups fresh or frozen cherries, 1 shallot minced, ½ cup dry red wine, ½ cup chicken broth, 2 tbsp butter, 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 1 tbsp brown sugar, fresh thyme
recipes.prep: Season and sear pork chops in hot oil 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through at 145°F (63°C). Remove and rest. In same pan cook shallot 2 minutes. Add wine and reduce. Add cherries, broth, balsamic, and brown sugar. Simmer 8 minutes until cherries soften and sauce thickens. Swirl in butter. Spoon cherry sauce over rested pork chops.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Dijon Cream
recipes.prep: Season chops and sear in hot oil 4–5 minutes per side. Remove. Cook shallots and garlic in butter 2 minutes. Add wine and reduce by half. Add cream and Dijon. Simmer until sauce thickens — about 5 minutes. Add tarragon. Return pork chops and heat through 2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Breaded Pork Cutlets
ingredients: 1 cup panko breadcrumbs mixed with ½ cup Parmesan
Lemon wedges and arugula salad to serve
recipes.prep: Season pork with salt and pepper. Coat in flour, then egg, then panko-Parmesan mixture pressing firmly. Pan fry in olive oil over medium heat 3–4 minutes per side until deeply golden and cooked through. Drain on wire rack. Serve topped with arugula dressed with lemon and olive oil. Finish with shaved Parmesan.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Apple and Onion
ingredients: 2 large apples, peeled, cored, and sliced
recipes.prep: Season and sear pork chops in hot oil 4 minutes per side. Remove. Melt butter in same pan. Cook onion over medium heat 10 minutes until soft. Add apple slices, brown sugar, and thyme and cook 3 minutes. Add cider and broth. Return pork chops. Cover and simmer 15 minutes until chops are cooked through and sauce has thickened slightly.

recipes.name: Cajun Pork Chops
ingredients: Cajun Rub: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp cayenne, ½ tsp dried thyme, salt and black pepper
recipes.prep: Mix Cajun rub. Coat pork chops generously on all sides. Let sit 30 minutes at room temperature. Heat oil in a cast iron skillet over high heat. Sear chops 4–5 minutes per side until charred and cooked through at 145°F (63°C). Rest 5 minutes. Serve with lime wedges and your choice of sides.

recipes.name: Pork Milanese
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops, pounded very thin
recipes.prep: Season pork with salt and pepper. Coat in flour, beaten eggs, then breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan. Pan fry in olive oil over medium heat 3 minutes per side until golden. Drain on a wire rack. Serve topped with arugula and cherry tomatoes tossed in lemon and olive oil. Top with shaved Parmesan.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Balsamic Glaze
ingredients: Balsamic Glaze: ½ cup balsamic vinegar, 2 tbsp honey, 2 garlic cloves minced, 1 tsp fresh rosemary
recipes.prep: Make glaze by simmering balsamic, honey, garlic, and rosemary until reduced by half and syrupy — about 8 minutes. Season pork chops with salt and pepper. Sear in hot oil in a cast iron 4 minutes per side. Brush with balsamic glaze in the last 2 minutes of cooking on each side. Internal temperature 145°F (63°C). Rest 5 minutes. Drizzle remaining glaze over before serving.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Gravy
ingredients: Gravy: 2 cups chicken broth, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 onion diced, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp butter, fresh thyme, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Season and dredge pork chops in flour. Sear in hot oil 4 minutes per side until golden. Remove. Cook onion in butter until soft. Add garlic 1 minute. Sprinkle flour over and stir 1 minute. Add broth and thyme gradually while stirring. Simmer until thickened. Return pork chops. Cover and simmer 20 minutes until tender and gravy is rich. Season with salt and pepper.

subcategories.name: Handhelds
subcategories.desc: Sandwiches, banh mi, tacos and wraps filled with pork.

recipes.name: Pork Gyros
ingredients: 1.5 lbs (680 g) pork shoulder, thinly sliced
Marinade: 3 tbsp olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp dried oregano, 1 tsp cumin, salt and pepper
Tzatziki: 1 cup Greek yogurt, 1 cucumber grated, 2 garlic cloves, dill, lemon juice
recipes.prep: Marinate pork at least 2 hours. Cook in a very hot skillet or grill pan in batches until slightly charred and cooked through. Slice thin. Make tzatziki. Warm pita bread. Top with pork, tzatziki, tomatoes, red onion, and lettuce. Wrap and serve.

recipes.name: Pork Souvlaki
ingredients: 1.5 lbs (680 g) pork shoulder or tenderloin, cubed
Marinade: 3 tbsp olive oil, juice of 2 lemons, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp dried oregano, salt and pepper
Tzatziki: 1 cup Greek yogurt, 1 cucumber grated, 2 garlic cloves, dill, lemon juice
recipes.prep: Marinate pork cubes at least 2 hours. Thread onto soaked wooden skewers. Grill over high heat 10–12 minutes turning regularly until cooked through and charred. Make tzatziki. Serve skewers in warm pita with tzatziki, tomatoes, red onion, and lettuce.

recipes.name: Cuban Sandwich
ingredients: ½ lb (225 g) roasted pork loin or mojo pork, thinly sliced
½ lb (225 g) deli ham, thinly sliced
recipes.prep: Spread yellow mustard on both sides of each roll. Layer ham, roasted pork, Swiss cheese, and pickles inside each roll. Butter the outside of the sandwich. Press in a sandwich press or heavy skillet weighted down with another pan over medium heat 4–5 minutes per side until bread is golden and crispy and cheese is fully melted. The sandwich should be flat and compressed. Cut diagonally and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Banh Mi
ingredients: Char Siu pork or Vietnamese pork meatballs
Pickled vegetables: 1 cup daikon and 1 cup carrots julienned, ½ cup rice vinegar, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt
Sriracha mayo: ½ cup mayo, 2 tbsp sriracha
recipes.prep: Make pickled vegetables by soaking daikon and carrots in vinegar, sugar, and salt solution 1 hour. Prepare char siu pork or meatballs. Make sriracha mayo. Split rolls and spread with sriracha mayo. Layer with pork, pickled vegetables, cucumber slices, cilantro, and jalapeño. The contrast of warm savory pork, tangy pickled vegetables, and fresh herbs is the essence of banh mi.

recipes.name: Pulled Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 3 cups pulled pork (see pulled pork recipe)
Coleslaw: 3 cups cabbage shredded, ½ cup mayo, 2 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Make pulled pork as in the recipe. Mix pulled pork with BBQ sauce until well coated. Make coleslaw by combining all ingredients and refrigerating 30 minutes. Toast brioche buns. Pile pulled pork generously on the bottom bun. Top with coleslaw and dill pickles. Add top bun. Serve immediately. The coleslaw on the sandwich is essential — it provides creamy crunch against the tender smoky pork.

recipes.name: Italian Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 1.5 lbs (680 g) Italian sausage or pork tenderloin, cooked and sliced
recipes.prep: Cook sausage or tenderloin. Drizzle inside of rolls with olive oil and sprinkle with dried oregano. Layer provolone on the bottom. Add hot sausage or pork. Top with giardiniera and banana peppers. Press together. The giardiniera provides the essential briny, spicy, crunchy contrast to the rich pork.

recipes.name: Pork Belly Banh Mi
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) pork belly, braised or roasted and sliced
recipes.prep: Slice braised or roasted pork belly into thin strips. Heat in a pan until caramelized. Split baguettes. Spread with sriracha mayo and pâté if using. Layer with warm pork belly slices, pickled vegetables, cucumber, cilantro, and jalapeño. Press together. The richness of the pork belly is balanced by the tangy pickled vegetables and fresh herbs.

recipes.name: Mojo Pork Tacos
ingredients: 2 cups mojo pork, shredded (see pernil or mojo pork recipe)
Toppings: pickled red onions, fresh cilantro, avocado, lime crema, lime wedges
recipes.prep: Warm shredded mojo pork in a pan until slightly crispy on the edges. Warm tortillas. Build tacos with pork, black beans, and rice. Top with pickled red onions, cilantro, and avocado. Drizzle with lime crema. Serve with lime wedges. The citrusy garlicky mojo pork is exceptional in taco form.

recipes.name: Pork Katsu Sandwich
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops, pounded thin and breaded
4 thick slices soft white bread or milk bread
recipes.prep: Fry breaded pork chops as in the Tonkatsu recipe until deeply golden. The key to a Japanese katsu sandwich is very fresh soft white bread. Spread Japanese mayo on both sides of each bread slice. Place shredded cabbage on the bottom. Add hot tonkatsu and drizzle generously with tonkatsu sauce. Top with second slice. Press firmly. Cut into thirds — the Japanese katsu sando is always cut into thirds revealing the layers. Wrap tightly in plastic for a few minutes for classic katsu sando texture.

recipes.name: Vietnamese Pork Meatball Banh Mi
ingredients: Meatballs: 1 lb (450 g) ground pork, 2 garlic cloves, 2 green onions, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp lemongrass minced, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp cornstarch
recipes.prep: Mix meatball ingredients until smooth. Roll into small balls. Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15 minutes or pan fry in oil until cooked through and golden. Build banh mi with sriracha mayo, warm meatballs, pickled vegetables, cucumber, cilantro, and jalapeño.

recipes.name: Pork Rib Sandwich
ingredients: 8 baby back rib portions, bones removed or boneless country ribs
recipes.prep: Cook ribs until very tender using the baby back rib recipe. Remove bones if present. Brush ribs generously with BBQ sauce and broil or grill until caramelized. Toast buttered buns. Place saucy ribs on the bottom bun. Top with coleslaw and pickles. Add top bun. Serve immediately — have lots of napkins ready.

recipes.name: Pork Carnitas Burrito
ingredients: 2 cups carnitas (see pork shoulder carnitas recipe)
recipes.prep: Warm carnitas in a skillet until crispy on edges. Warm tortillas. Lay each tortilla flat. Layer rice, beans, carnitas, pico de gallo, avocado, sour cream, and cheese in the center. Fold sides in and roll tightly from bottom to top. For a crispy burrito toast in a dry skillet 1–2 minutes per side until golden.

recipes.name: Pork Banh Mi with Lemongrass
ingredients: 1.5 lbs (680 g) pork shoulder, thinly sliced
Marinade: 2 stalks lemongrass minced, 4 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp turmeric
Pickled vegetables, cucumber, cilantro, jalapeño, sriracha mayo
recipes.prep: Marinate pork at least 2 hours. Cook in a very hot skillet or grill pan in batches until slightly charred and caramelized — about 2 minutes per side. Build banh mi with sriracha mayo, lemongrass pork, pickled vegetables, cucumber, cilantro, and jalapeño.

recipes.name: Pork Belly Tacos
ingredients: 1.5 lbs (680 g) pork belly, braised until tender and sliced
Toppings: pickled red onions, shredded cabbage, avocado, salsa verde, cilantro, lime
Chipotle crema: ½ cup sour cream, 2 chipotle peppers, lime juice
recipes.prep: Slice braised pork belly and pan-fry in a dry skillet over high heat until caramelized and edges are crispy. Warm tortillas. Build tacos with pork belly, shredded cabbage, pickled onions, and avocado. Drizzle with salsa verde and chipotle crema. Garnish with cilantro and lime.

recipes.name: Ham and Swiss Croissant
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Split croissants. Mix Dijon mustard with a little honey and spread on the inside of each croissant. Layer 2 slices Swiss cheese and 2 slices ham inside each croissant. Close and place on a baking sheet. Brush tops with melted butter. Bake 12–15 minutes until croissants are golden and cheese is melted. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Pulled Pork Quesadilla
ingredients: 2 cups shredded Monterey Jack and cheddar blend
Sour cream and guacamole to serve
recipes.prep: Mix pulled pork with a little BBQ sauce. In a dry skillet over medium heat lay a tortilla flat. Sprinkle cheese on half. Add pulled pork and jalapeños. Fold over. Cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden and crispy and cheese is melted. Slice into wedges. Serve with sour cream and guacamole.

subcategories.name: Ribs
subcategories.desc: Baby back, spare and country-style ribs.

recipes.name: Pork Ribs
ingredients: Dry Rub: 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp cumin, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Remove membrane from back of ribs. Apply dry rub generously on all sides. Wrap tightly in foil. Bake at 275°F for 2.5–3 hours until tender. Carefully unwrap. Mix BBQ sauce with vinegar. Brush ribs with sauce. Grill or broil 5–10 minutes per side until caramelized and sticky. Apply more sauce and cook another 5 minutes. Rest 5 minutes before cutting between bones.

recipes.name: Baby Back Ribs
ingredients: Dry Rub: 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp black pepper, ½ tsp cayenne, ½ tsp cumin
recipes.prep: Remove membrane from the back of each rack by loosening an edge with a knife and pulling off with a paper towel. Apply dry rub generously on all sides. Wrap tightly in foil. Refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 275°F (135°C). Place foil-wrapped ribs on a baking sheet. Bake 2.5–3 hours until very tender. Open foil and pour in apple juice. Reseal and bake 30 more minutes. Unwrap and brush generously with BBQ sauce. Broil or grill 5–8 minutes until sauce caramelizes. Rest 10 minutes before cutting between bones.

recipes.name: St. Louis Spare Ribs
ingredients: 2 racks St. Louis style spare ribs
Dry Rub: 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp cayenne
Apple cider vinegar in a spray bottle
recipes.prep: Remove membrane from ribs. Apply dry rub generously. Refrigerate overnight. Smoke at 225°F (107°C) using hickory or apple wood for 3 hours spritzing with apple cider vinegar every 45 minutes. Wrap in foil with a splash of apple juice. Smoke 2 more hours. Unwrap and brush with BBQ sauce. Smoke unwrapped 1 final hour until sauce sets and ribs are deeply mahogany. Rest 15 minutes before slicing. For oven method: bake foil-wrapped at 275°F (135°C) for 3 hours then broil with sauce.

recipes.name: Pork Ribs with Dry Rub
ingredients: Dry Rub: 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp dried mustard, ½ tsp cayenne
recipes.prep: Remove membrane from the back of ribs. Apply dry rub all over both sides pressing firmly. Refrigerate overnight. For oven: preheat to 275°F (135°C). Place ribs meat side down on a baking sheet. Cover tightly with foil. Bake 2.5–3 hours until tender when pierced with a fork. Uncover and broil 5 minutes for a crusty exterior. No BBQ sauce needed — the dry rub creates a beautiful crust.

recipes.name: Ribs with Honey Bourbon Glaze
ingredients: Dry Rub: 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder
Glaze: ½ cup bourbon, ½ cup honey, ¼ cup soy sauce, 2 tbsp Dijon mustard, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
recipes.prep: Apply dry rub to ribs. Wrap in foil. Bake at 275°F (135°C) for 2.5 hours. Make glaze by simmering all glaze ingredients until reduced by half and syrupy. Unwrap ribs. Brush generously with bourbon glaze. Broil or grill 6–8 minutes brushing with more glaze every 2 minutes until sticky and caramelized. Rest 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.name: Pork Neck Bones
recipes.prep: Season neck bones generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Brown in batches in hot oil in a large Dutch oven. Remove. Cook onion and garlic until soft. Return neck bones. Add broth, water, Worcestershire sauce, and thyme. Bring to a boil. Cover and braise in oven at 325°F (165°C) for 2.5–3 hours until meat is very tender and falling off the bone. Serve over white rice with braising liquid spooned over.

recipes.name: BBQ Pork Spare Ribs
ingredients: Dry Rub: 2 tbsp salt, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, ½ tsp cayenne
recipes.prep: Remove membrane. Apply dry rub. Refrigerate overnight. Place ribs meat side down in a roasting pan. Add apple juice. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 275°F (135°C) for 3–3.5 hours until tender. Remove foil. Brush generously with BBQ sauce. Increase heat to 375°F (190°C) and bake uncovered 20 minutes basting every 5 minutes until sauce is sticky and caramelized. Rest 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.name: Country Style Pork Ribs
ingredients: 3 lbs (1.4 kg) country style pork ribs
Dry Rub: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp brown sugar
recipes.prep: Apply dry rub to country ribs. For slow cooker: place ribs and broth in slow cooker. Cook on LOW 6–8 hours until very tender. Drain liquid. Brush with BBQ sauce. Broil 5 minutes until caramelized. For oven: place in a roasting pan with broth. Cover and bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2.5 hours. Uncover, brush with BBQ sauce, and bake 30 more minutes.

subcategories.name: Roasts
subcategories.desc: Loin, tenderloin, braises and whole roasts.

recipes.name: Pork Loin Roast
ingredients: 1.5 kg (3 lbs) center-cut pork loin roast
1 cup (240 ml) white wine for roasting pan
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Make small incisions all over pork and insert garlic slices. Mix mustard, olive oil, and herbs. Coat pork all over. Season generously with salt and pepper. Place on a rack in a roasting pan. Pour wine into pan. Roast 60–70 minutes until internal temperature reaches 145°F. Baste occasionally. Rest 15 minutes before slicing. Use pan drippings to make a simple pan sauce.

recipes.name: Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloins, about 500 g (1 lb) each
Pan sauce: ½ cup white wine, ½ cup chicken broth, 2 tbsp butter
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat pork dry. Mix garlic, mustard, olive oil, thyme, rosemary, salt and pepper. Coat pork all over. Heat an oven-safe skillet over high heat. Sear tenderloins on all sides until browned — about 2 minutes per side. Transfer to oven and roast 15–18 minutes until internal temperature reaches 145°F. Rest 5 minutes. Make pan sauce with wine and broth. Slice and serve with sauce.

recipes.name: Mojo Pork
ingredients: Mojo Marinade: 1 cup sour orange juice or ½ cup lime and ½ cup orange juice, ¾ cup olive oil, 8 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper
Fresh cilantro and lime to serve
recipes.prep: Blend mojo marinade until smooth. Score pork deeply all over. Pour marinade over pork. Marinate at least 4 hours or overnight in the refrigerator. Bring to room temperature 1 hour. Roast at 325°F (165°C) for 4–5 hours until very tender and internal temperature reaches 195°F (90°C). Rest 30 minutes. Shred or slice. Serve with fresh cilantro, lime, black beans, and rice.

recipes.name: Herb Roasted Pork Loin
ingredients: 3 lbs (1.4 kg) boneless pork loin roast
Herb Rub: 4 garlic cloves minced, 2 tbsp fresh rosemary, 2 tbsp fresh thyme, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 3 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper
Pan Sauce: 1 cup white wine, 1 cup chicken broth, 2 shallots, 2 tbsp butter
recipes.prep: Score top of pork loin. Apply herb rub all over and refrigerate overnight. Bring to room temperature 1 hour. Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C). Sear pork in a hot oven-safe skillet on all sides. Transfer to oven and roast 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 325°F (165°C) and continue roasting until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C) — about 45–60 minutes more. Rest 15 minutes. Make pan sauce with drippings, wine, broth, and shallots. Swirl in butter.

recipes.name: Braised Pork Cheeks
recipes.prep: Season pork cheeks generously. Brown in batches in hot oil in a Dutch oven. Remove. Cook vegetables until soft. Add tomato paste 2 minutes. Add wine and reduce by half. Return pork. Add broth and herbs. Braise covered in oven at 300°F (150°C) for 3–4 hours until very tender and sauce is rich. Remove cheeks and reduce sauce until glossy. Serve over creamy polenta or mashed potatoes.

recipes.name: Stuffed Pork Loin
ingredients: 3 lbs (1.4 kg) boneless pork loin, butterflied open
Filling: 1 cup spinach sautéed, ½ cup sun-dried tomatoes, ½ cup Parmesan, 4 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp pine nuts, 2 tbsp fresh basil, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Butterfly pork loin by cutting horizontally almost all the way through and opening like a book. Pound to even thickness. Spread filling over interior leaving a ½-inch border. Roll tightly and tie with kitchen twine at 1-inch intervals. Season outside with salt and pepper. Sear on all sides in hot olive oil. Roast at 350°F (175°C) for 50–60 minutes until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C). Rest 15 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Pork Osso Buco
ingredients: Gremolata: lemon zest, garlic, fresh parsley
recipes.prep: Season pork shanks. Brown on all sides in hot oil in a Dutch oven. Remove. Cook vegetables until soft. Add wine and reduce by half. Add broth, tomatoes, and herbs. Return shanks. Braise covered at 325°F (165°C) for 2–2.5 hours until very tender. Make gremolata by mixing lemon zest, minced garlic, and parsley. Serve shanks over risotto or polenta topped with gremolata.

recipes.name: Porchetta
ingredients: 4 lbs (1.8 kg) pork belly, skin on
Filling: 6 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp fresh rosemary, 2 tbsp fresh sage, 1 tbsp fennel seeds, 1 tsp red pepper flakes, lemon zest, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Score the pork belly skin. Open flat skin side down. Mix filling ingredients into a paste. Spread generously over the meat side. Roll tightly into a log skin side out. Tie with kitchen twine every 2 inches. Season outside with salt only. Refrigerate uncovered overnight to dry the skin. Roast at 450°F (230°C) for 30 minutes until skin blisters and crackles. Reduce to 325°F (165°C) and roast 1.5–2 more hours until very tender. Rest 20 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Pork Tenderloin with Apple Pan Sauce
recipes.prep: Season tenderloins with salt and pepper. Sear in hot oil in an oven-safe skillet on all sides. Transfer to oven at 400°F (200°C) and roast 15–18 minutes until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C). Rest 5 minutes. In same skillet cook shallots in butter 2 minutes. Add apples and cook 3 minutes. Add cider and broth. Reduce until slightly syrupy. Add thyme and season with salt and pepper. Slice tenderloin and serve with apple pan sauce.

recipes.name: Pork Crown Roast
ingredients: One crown roast of pork ribs (8–10 ribs), shaped by your butcher
Herb Butter: 4 tbsp butter softened, 4 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp rosemary, 2 tbsp sage, salt and pepper
Stuffing: 3 cups breadcrumbs, 1 onion, 3 celery stalks, 4 tbsp butter, apple, fresh herbs, chicken broth
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C). Apply herb butter all over roast. Season generously. Roast 20 minutes until browned. Make stuffing and fill center of crown. Reduce heat to 325°F (165°C). Continue roasting until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C) — about 20 minutes per pound from the start. Rest 20 minutes before carving between ribs.

recipes.name: Braised Pork with Sauerkraut
ingredients: 3 lbs (1.4 kg) pork shoulder, cut into large pieces
recipes.prep: Season pork and brown in batches in hot oil in a Dutch oven. Remove. Cook onion until soft. Return pork. Add sauerkraut, broth, wine, caraway seeds, and bay leaves. Bring to a boil. Cover and braise in oven at 325°F (165°C) for 2.5–3 hours until pork is very tender. Remove bay leaves. Adjust seasoning. Serve with boiled potatoes or egg noodles.

recipes.name: Pork Roast with Crackling
ingredients: 4 lbs (1.8 kg) bone-in pork loin with skin
Herb Rub for meat: 4 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp fresh rosemary, 1 tbsp fennel seeds, 2 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Score pork skin very deeply in a crosshatch pattern going all the way through the fat to the meat. Rub coarse salt vigorously into all the scores. Refrigerate uncovered overnight. Pat skin dry. Rub herb mixture on the meat side and in the scores. Roast at 450°F (230°C) for 30 minutes until skin crackles and blisters. Reduce to 325°F (165°C) and roast until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C). Rest 20 minutes. The crackling should be shatteringly crispy.

recipes.name: Pork and Apple Cider Braise
ingredients: 3 lbs (1.4 kg) pork shoulder, cut into large pieces
recipes.prep: Season pork and brown in batches in hot oil. Remove. Cook onion until soft. Add garlic 1 minute. Add Dijon and stir. Add cider, broth, apples, and herbs. Return pork. Bring to a boil. Cover and braise in oven at 325°F (165°C) for 2.5 hours until very tender. Remove pork and blend sauce until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Return pork to serve.

recipes.name: Al Pastor Pork
ingredients: 3 lbs (1.4 kg) pork shoulder, thinly sliced
Marinade: 3 dried guajillo chiles, 2 dried ancho chiles, 4 chipotle peppers in adobo, ½ pineapple juice, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp achiote paste, salt
Corn tortillas, cilantro, diced onion, and lime to serve
recipes.prep: Toast dried chiles and soak in hot water 20 minutes. Blend with chipotles, pineapple juice, garlic, and spices. Marinate pork overnight. Stack marinated pork slices vertically with pineapple slices between layers — traditional al pastor is cooked on a trompo spit. For home cooking grill over high heat in batches or broil 5–6 minutes per side. Chop and serve in warm corn tortillas with cilantro, onion, fresh pineapple, and lime.

recipes.name: Pernil (Puerto Rican Roast Pork)
ingredients: 6 lbs (2.7 kg) bone-in pork shoulder with skin
Adobo Paste: 8 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp dried oregano, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp black pepper, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tbsp white wine vinegar
Sofrito: ½ cup green peppers, ½ cup cilantro, 4 garlic cloves, 1 small onion
recipes.prep: Score pork skin deeply. Make deep cuts all over the meat. Blend adobo paste and sofrito together. Push paste deep into all cuts. Coat entire exterior. Marinate overnight. Bring to room temperature 1 hour. Roast at 400°F (200°C) for 1 hour with skin up. Reduce to 300°F (150°C). Cover with foil and braise 3–4 hours until fork tender. Uncover. Increase to 425°F (220°C) and roast 20–30 minutes until skin crackles and becomes chicharrón-style crispy.

recipes.name: Cuban Lechón
ingredients: Mojo: 1 cup sour orange juice or lime juice, ½ cup olive oil, 8 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp oregano, salt and pepper
Black beans and rice for serving
recipes.prep: Score pork and make deep cuts all over. Blend mojo ingredients and pour over pork. Marinate overnight. Roast at 325°F (165°C) for 4–5 hours until very tender at 195°F (90°C). Rest 20 minutes. Shred or pull apart. Serve with black beans and rice. Also excellent sliced and served with mojo drizzled over.

subcategories.name: Shoulder
subcategories.desc: Pulled, smoked, slow-cooked and carnitas-style shoulder.

recipes.name: Carnitas
ingredients: 1.5 kg (3 lbs) pork shoulder, cut into large chunks
Tortillas, salsa, and toppings to serve
recipes.prep: Combine all ingredients in a large pot or Dutch oven. Add enough water to barely cover. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer uncovered 2 hours until liquid mostly evaporates and pork is very tender. Increase heat and let pork fry in remaining fat, turning occasionally until caramelized and crispy on the outside. Shred and serve in warm tortillas with salsa, cilantro, and lime.

recipes.name: Pulled Pork
ingredients: 2 kg (4.5 lbs) pork shoulder or butt
Dry Rub: 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp onion powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp cayenne, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper
recipes.prep: Mix dry rub and coat pork all over. Refrigerate overnight if possible. Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C). Place pork fat side up in a roasting pan. Add vinegar and broth to the bottom. Cover tightly with foil. Roast 6–7 hours until meat shreds easily with a fork and internal temperature reaches 205°F. Rest 30 minutes. Shred with two forks removing any fat. Toss with BBQ sauce. Serve on brioche buns with coleslaw.

recipes.name: Slow Cooker Pork Shoulder
ingredients: ½ cup (120 ml) apple cider vinegar
recipes.prep: Mix spices and coat pork all over. Sear in oil on all sides in a skillet until browned. Place onions at the bottom of a slow cooker. Set pork on top. Mix broth, vinegar, and brown sugar and pour around pork. Cook on low 8–10 hours or high 5–6 hours until falling apart. Shred with forks. Serve over rice or in sandwiches.

recipes.name: Smoked Pork Shoulder
ingredients: Dry Rub: 3 tbsp salt, 2 tbsp coarsely ground black pepper, 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cayenne
recipes.prep: Apply dry rub all over pork shoulder and refrigerate overnight uncovered so rub forms a crust. Set smoker to 225°F (107°C) with wood chips. Smoke fat side up 8–10 hours until internal temperature reaches 195–205°F (90–96°C). Wrap in butcher paper at 160°F (71°C) to push through the stall. Rest wrapped in a cooler 1–2 hours before pulling. The low slow smoke creates an incredible dark mahogany bark.

recipes.name: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork
ingredients: Dry Rub: 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper, ½ tsp cayenne
½ cup (120 ml) apple cider vinegar
recipes.prep: Apply dry rub all over pork. Place in slow cooker. Pour broth and vinegar around the meat. Cook on LOW 8–10 hours or HIGH 5–6 hours until completely fall-apart tender. Remove pork and shred with two forks. Skim fat from cooking juices. Mix shredded pork with cooking juices and BBQ sauce. Serve on buns with coleslaw.

recipes.name: Carolina Pulled Pork
ingredients: Dry Rub: 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder
Eastern Carolina Sauce: 1 cup apple cider vinegar, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp red pepper flakes, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp salt
recipes.prep: Apply dry rub and refrigerate overnight. Roast covered in oven at 300°F (150°C) for 5 hours or smoke at 225°F (107°C) until internal temperature reaches 205°F (96°C). Rest and shred. Make Carolina sauce by combining all ingredients. Toss pulled pork generously with the tangy vinegar sauce instead of sweet BBQ sauce. Serve on buns with coleslaw.

recipes.name: Pork Shoulder Carnitas
ingredients: 4 lbs (1.8 kg) boneless pork shoulder, cut into 3-inch chunks
Corn tortillas, cilantro, onion, and lime to serve
recipes.prep: Season pork with cumin, oregano, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Brown in lard in a Dutch oven in batches. Return all pork. Add orange juice, lime juice, and garlic. Bring to a boil. Cover and braise in oven at 300°F (150°C) for 3 hours until very tender. Remove pork and shred roughly. Spread on a baking sheet. Broil 5–8 minutes until edges are crispy. Serve in warm corn tortillas with cilantro, diced onion, and lime.

recipes.name: Hawaiian Kalua Pork
ingredients: 1 tbsp Hawaiian sea salt or kosher salt
4 large ti leaves or banana leaves (or foil if unavailable)
recipes.prep: Pierce pork all over with a fork. Rub with salt. Drizzle liquid smoke over all sides. Wrap tightly in ti leaves or foil creating a sealed packet. Place in a slow cooker. Cook on LOW 16–20 hours or in oven at 325°F (165°C) for 5 hours until completely fall-apart tender. Shred with two forks. Mix with accumulated juices. Traditional Hawaiian kalua pork is cooked in an imu underground oven — this is the home version.

recipes.name: Slow Roasted Pork Shoulder
ingredients: Paste: 6 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp fresh rosemary, 2 tbsp fresh thyme, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp fennel seeds, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Make herb paste in a food processor. Score pork deeply all over with a knife. Rub paste into cuts and all over the exterior. Refrigerate overnight. Bring to room temperature 1 hour. Place in a roasting pan. Pour wine and broth around the base. Roast covered at 325°F (165°C) for 4–5 hours until very tender and internal temperature reaches 195°F (90°C). Uncover last 30 minutes to crisp the exterior. Rest 20 minutes before serving.

subcategories.name: Asian
subcategories.desc: Pork dishes from China, Japan, Vietnam, Thailand, the Philippines and India.

recipes.name: Char Siu BBQ Pork
ingredients: 700 g (1.5 lbs) pork shoulder or loin, sliced into strips
Marinade: 3 tbsp hoisin sauce, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp Shaoxing wine, 1 tsp five spice powder, 3 garlic cloves, red food coloring (optional)
recipes.prep: Mix all marinade ingredients. Coat pork strips thoroughly. Marinate at least 4 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 425°F. Place pork on a rack over a foil-lined baking tray. Roast 25 minutes. Flip, brush with reserved marinade, and roast 15 more minutes. Brush with honey and broil 3–5 minutes until caramelized and slightly charred at the edges. Slice and serve over rice or in steamed buns.

recipes.name: Pork Gyoza
ingredients: 2 cups napa cabbage, finely chopped and salted
Dipping sauce: soy sauce, rice vinegar, chili oil
recipes.prep: Salt cabbage and let sit 10 minutes. Squeeze out all water. Mix with pork, green onions, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, and sugar. Place a teaspoon of filling on each wrapper. Fold and pleat edges to seal. Heat oil in a flat skillet. Add gyoza flat side down. Cook until golden — about 3 minutes. Add ¼ cup water, cover immediately, and steam 5 minutes. Uncover and cook until water evaporates. Serve with dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Pork Vindaloo
ingredients: Paste: 6 dried red chilies soaked, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp mustard seeds, 5 garlic cloves, 1-inch ginger, ¼ cup white wine vinegar
recipes.prep: Blend paste ingredients until smooth. Marinate pork in paste at least 2 hours. Heat oil in a heavy pot. Cook onion until dark golden. Add marinated pork and stir fry 5 minutes. Add a splash of water. Cover and cook over medium-low heat 45–60 minutes until pork is very tender and oil has separated. Season with salt and a pinch of sugar to balance. Serve with basmati rice.

recipes.name: Vietnamese Caramel Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs (900 g) pork belly or shoulder, cut into 2-inch cubes
Caramel: ½ cup sugar, 3 tbsp water
Braising Liquid: 3 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 cups (480 ml) coconut water, 3 garlic cloves, 1-inch ginger, black pepper
Fresh cilantro and steamed rice to serve
recipes.prep: Make caramel by cooking sugar and water over medium-high heat without stirring until deep amber. Add braising liquid carefully — it will sizzle. Add pork and bring to a boil. Skim foam. Cover and simmer on low heat 1.5 hours until pork is very tender and sauce is thick and mahogany colored. Add soft boiled eggs in the last 15 minutes. Serve over steamed rice garnished with cilantro.

recipes.name: Moo Shu Pork
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) pork tenderloin, thinly sliced
1 cup wood ear mushrooms, soaked and sliced
Sauce: 3 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tsp sugar
Hoisin sauce and green onions for serving
recipes.prep: Stir fry pork in a hot wok until cooked. Remove. Scramble eggs lightly and remove. Add garlic and ginger. Add mushrooms and cabbage and stir fry 3 minutes. Return pork and eggs. Add sauce and toss. Serve with warm mandarin pancakes or tortillas. Spread hoisin on each pancake, add moo shu pork, and top with green onions. Roll and eat.

recipes.name: Pork Katsu Curry
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops, pounded thin, breaded and fried (see Tonkatsu recipe)
