Japanese Curry Sauce: 2 tbsp butter, 1 onion diced, 2 carrots diced, 2 potatoes cubed, 2 cups chicken broth, 2 boxes Japanese curry roux, 1 tbsp soy sauce
recipes.prep: Make tonkatsu as in the recipe above. Make curry sauce by cooking onion in butter until golden. Add carrots and potatoes. Add broth and simmer 20 minutes until tender. Remove from heat and add curry roux blocks stirring until dissolved. Return to low heat and simmer 10 minutes until thick. Slice pork tonkatsu and serve over rice with curry sauce poured alongside.

recipes.name: Thai Basil Pork
ingredients: Sauce: 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sugar
Steamed rice and fried egg to serve
recipes.prep: Mix sauce ingredients. Heat oil in a wok over very high heat until smoking. Add garlic and chilies and stir fry 30 seconds. Add ground pork and cook on high heat without stirring until bottom browns. Break up and stir fry until cooked through and slightly crispy. Add sauce and toss. Remove from heat and fold in fresh Thai basil. Serve immediately over steamed rice with a crispy fried egg on top.

recipes.name: Filipino Adobo Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs (900 g) pork shoulder, cut into 2-inch cubes
½ cup (120 ml) white cane vinegar
recipes.prep: Combine soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, peppercorns, and bay leaves. Add pork and marinate 30 minutes. Bring to a boil. Reduce and simmer covered 40 minutes. Remove pork. Reduce sauce by half over high heat. Heat oil in a skillet and fry pork until crispy and golden. Pour reduced sauce over pork. The tangy, savory, slightly caramelized sauce is the defining characteristic of Filipino adobo. Serve over steamed white rice.

subcategories.name: Bacon
subcategories.desc: Bacon dishes and bacon-wrapped favorites.

recipes.name: Bacon Wrapped Dates
ingredients: 4 oz (115 g) goat cheese or blue cheese
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Stuff each date with a small amount of goat cheese or blue cheese. Wrap each stuffed date with a half strip of bacon and secure with a toothpick. Place on a wire rack over a baking sheet. Bake 15–18 minutes until bacon is crispy and caramelized. The combination of sweet sticky dates, creamy tangy cheese, and salty crispy bacon is irresistible. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Bacon Jam
ingredients: ½ cup (120 ml) strong brewed coffee
½ cup (120 ml) apple cider vinegar
recipes.prep: Cook bacon in a heavy skillet over medium heat until crispy. Remove bacon and drain most of fat leaving 2 tbsp. Cook onions in bacon fat over medium-low heat 20 minutes until deeply golden. Add garlic and cook 2 minutes. Add all remaining ingredients including cooked bacon. Stir well. Simmer on low heat 45–60 minutes stirring occasionally until mixture is very thick and jammy. Cool slightly then pulse in a food processor 4–5 times for a spreadable consistency. Store refrigerated up to 2 weeks.

recipes.name: Bacon Wrapped Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: Herb Rub: 3 garlic cloves minced, 1 tbsp fresh rosemary, 1 tbsp fresh thyme, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 2 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Mix herb rub and coat tenderloins all over. Lay 4 strips of bacon on a work surface overlapping slightly. Place tenderloin at the edge and roll tightly. Secure with toothpicks. Repeat with second tenderloin. Heat an oven-safe skillet over high heat. Sear all sides of wrapped tenderloins until bacon is browned — about 4 minutes. Transfer to oven and roast 15–18 minutes until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C). Rest 5 minutes. Slice and serve.

recipes.name: Bacon Carbonara
ingredients: 200 g (7 oz) thick-cut bacon or pancetta, diced
4 large egg yolks plus 1 whole egg
100 g (3.5 oz) Pecorino Romano, finely grated
recipes.prep: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente. While pasta cooks render bacon in a large skillet until crispy. Remove from heat. Whisk egg yolks, whole egg, and cheeses together with generous black pepper. Reserve 1 cup pasta water. Drain pasta and add to skillet off the heat. Add egg mixture tossing quickly while adding pasta water a splash at a time until sauce is creamy and coats the pasta. Serve immediately topped with extra black pepper.

recipes.name: BLT with Thick Bacon
ingredients: 4 slices sourdough or artisan bread, toasted
recipes.prep: Cook thick-cut bacon in a cold skillet over medium heat turning occasionally until very crispy but not burnt — about 8–10 minutes. Drain on a wire rack. Toast bread. Spread mayo generously on both slices. Season tomato slices with salt and pepper. Layer lettuce, tomato, and crispy bacon on one slice. Top with second slice. Slice diagonally. The secret to a great BLT is thick-cut bacon, perfectly ripe tomatoes, and enough mayo.

subcategories.name: Barbecue
subcategories.desc: Smoked and slow-cooked pork barbecue.

recipes.name: Pulled Pork Sandwiches
ingredients: Dry rub: 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp onion powder, 1 tsp cayenne, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tsp pepper
recipes.prep: Apply dry rub and refrigerate overnight. Smoke at 225–250°F with hickory wood for 8–10 hours. Mop with apple cider vinegar mixture every hour. Wrap in foil at 165°F. Continue until 205°F. Rest 1 hour. Shred with two forks discarding fat. Toss with BBQ sauce. Serve on brioche buns piled with coleslaw.

recipes.name: Smoked Ribs
ingredients: 2 racks spare ribs or baby back ribs
Dry rub: 3 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp onion powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp cayenne, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper
recipes.prep: Remove membrane from back of ribs. Apply dry rub generously on all sides. Smoke at 225°F with hickory or apple wood for 3 hours. Spritz with apple juice every 45 minutes. Wrap tightly in foil with a splash of apple juice. Continue smoking 2 more hours. Unwrap. Brush with BBQ sauce and smoke unwrapped 1 final hour. Rest 15 minutes. Slice between bones.

name: Seafood
desc: Fish, shrimp, crab, lobster, shellfish, sushi and more.

subcategories.name: Clams
subcategories.desc: Chowders, steamed clams and linguine.

recipes.name: New England Clam Chowder
ingredients: 3 cans (6.5 oz each) chopped clams — reserve liquid
Fresh chives and oyster crackers to serve
recipes.prep: Cook bacon in a large pot until crispy. Remove and set aside. Cook onion, celery, and garlic in bacon fat until soft. Add flour and stir 2 minutes. Gradually add clam liquid and milk while stirring to avoid lumps. Add potatoes and thyme. Simmer 15 minutes until potatoes are tender. Add heavy cream and chopped clams. Heat through — do not boil after adding clams or they will become rubbery. Season with salt and white pepper. Serve topped with bacon, chives, and oyster crackers.

recipes.name: Manhattan Clam Chowder
ingredients: 3 cans (6.5 oz each) chopped clams, liquid reserved
3 cups (720 ml) seafood or chicken broth
Salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes
recipes.prep: Cook bacon until crispy. Cook onion, celery, carrots, and garlic in bacon fat until soft. Add crushed tomatoes and cook 5 minutes. Add broth, reserved clam liquid, potatoes, thyme, and bay leaf. Simmer 20 minutes until potatoes are tender. Add clams and heat through. Season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Remove bay leaf. Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Steamed Clams with Garlic and Wine
recipes.prep: Soak clams in cold salted water 30 minutes to purge sand. Drain and scrub. Discard any that do not close when tapped. Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Cook shallots and garlic with red pepper flakes 2 minutes. Add wine and bring to a boil. Add clams. Cover tightly and cook 6–8 minutes until all clams open. Discard any that remain closed. Season broth. Ladle into bowls with plenty of broth. Garnish with parsley. Serve with crusty bread for dipping.

recipes.name: Clams Casino
ingredients: 24 littleneck clams, scrubbed and opened on the half shell
Topping: 6 strips bacon diced and cooked, 1 red bell pepper finely diced, 3 shallots minced, 3 garlic cloves minced, 3 tbsp butter, ¼ cup breadcrumbs, 2 tbsp Parmesan, fresh parsley, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C). Cook shallots, garlic, and red pepper in butter until soft. Mix with crispy bacon, breadcrumbs, and Parmesan. Season with salt and pepper. Nestle clams in their half shells in a baking pan filled with rock salt. Top each clam with a generous spoonful of topping. Bake 10–12 minutes until topping is golden and clams are just cooked. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Clam Linguine (Linguine alle Vongole)
ingredients: ¼ cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
recipes.prep: Soak clams in salted water 30 minutes to purge grit. Cook linguine until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water. Heat olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and red pepper flakes and cook until golden. Add wine and bring to a boil. Add clams, cover, and cook until all open — about 5–7 minutes. Discard any that do not open. Drain pasta and add to clam pan. Toss vigorously over high heat adding pasta water as needed. Stir in parsley.

subcategories.name: Crab
subcategories.desc: Crab cakes, legs and crab dishes.

recipes.name: Crab Cakes
ingredients: 450 g (1 lb) fresh lump crab meat
recipes.prep: Gently mix crab meat with mayonnaise, egg, mustard, Worcestershire, Old Bay, breadcrumbs, green onions, and parsley. Season with salt and pepper. Be careful not to break up the crab too much. Form into patties. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Pan fry in butter and oil over medium heat 3–4 minutes per side until deeply golden. Drain on paper towels. Serve with remoulade sauce and lemon.

recipes.name: Steamed Dungeness Crab
ingredients: 2 whole Dungeness crabs, live or precooked
1 cup (240 ml) white wine or beer
Bay leaves and Old Bay seasoning
Melted butter and lemon for serving
recipes.prep: If using live crabs humanely dispatch by placing in freezer 30 minutes. Set up a large pot with a steamer insert. Add wine, water, garlic, lemon, bay leaves, and a generous amount of Old Bay. Bring to a boil. Place crabs in steamer. Cover and steam 15–18 minutes for whole crabs until shell is bright red. Rest 5 minutes. Crack legs and claws with a mallet. Serve with melted butter and lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Crab Linguine
ingredients: ½ cup (120 ml) dry white wine
recipes.prep: Cook linguine until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook shallots and garlic 2 minutes. Add wine and reduce by half. Add butter and lemon juice and zest. Add crab meat and toss gently to warm through — do not break it up too much. Add pasta and toss with pasta water as needed. Add red pepper flakes and parsley. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Crab Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: Filling: 8 oz (225 g) cream cheese softened, 1 cup lump crab meat, ¼ cup Parmesan, 2 green onions minced, 2 garlic cloves minced, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp Old Bay, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Mix cream cheese, crab, Parmesan, green onions, garlic, lemon juice, and Old Bay until well combined. Season with salt and pepper. Fill each mushroom cap generously. Mix a little panko with Parmesan and sprinkle on top. Drizzle with olive oil. Bake 20–25 minutes until mushrooms are tender and topping is golden.

recipes.name: Crab Dip
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Beat cream cheese until smooth. Mix in mayonnaise, sour cream, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, and Old Bay. Fold in crab, mozzarella, Parmesan, and green onions. Season with salt and cayenne. Transfer to a baking dish. Bake 25 minutes until hot and bubbly. Serve with crusty bread, crackers, or tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Maryland Crab Soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) blue crab claws or lump crab meat
recipes.prep: In a large pot combine broth, crushed tomatoes, and Old Bay. Bring to a boil. Add onion, celery, carrots, and potatoes. Simmer 15 minutes. Add corn, green beans, and crab. Simmer 10 more minutes until all vegetables are tender and crab is heated through. Adjust seasoning. Garnish with fresh parsley. This is a classic Maryland blue crab soup.

recipes.name: Crab Rangoon
ingredients: Filling: 8 oz (225 g) cream cheese softened, 6 oz (170 g) crab meat, 2 green onions minced, 1 garlic clove minced, 1 tsp soy sauce, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, salt
Sweet chili sauce or duck sauce for dipping
recipes.prep: Mix filling ingredients until smooth. Place a small spoonful in the center of each wonton wrapper. Wet edges with water. Fold into triangles or pull all corners up to the center and pinch to seal into a purse shape. Heat 2 inches of oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry in batches 2–3 minutes until golden and crispy. Drain. Serve with sweet chili sauce or duck sauce.

recipes.name: Soft Shell Crab
ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal seasoned with Old Bay, salt and pepper
Remoulade sauce and lemon to serve
recipes.prep: Dip each crab in buttermilk, then dredge in flour, back in buttermilk, then in seasoned cornmeal. Press firmly to adhere. Heat 1 inch of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat to 350°F (175°C). Fry crabs 3 minutes per side until golden and crispy. They will splatter — be careful. Drain on a wire rack. Serve immediately with remoulade sauce and lemon.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter King Crab Legs
ingredients: 2 lbs (900 g) king crab legs, split
Garlic Butter: ½ cup (115 g) unsalted butter, 5 garlic cloves minced, 1 tbsp fresh parsley, juice of ½ lemon, pinch of cayenne
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Split crab legs lengthwise if not already split. Place in a baking dish flesh side up. Make garlic butter by melting butter with garlic, parsley, lemon juice, and cayenne. Spoon generously over exposed crab meat. Bake 12–15 minutes until heated through and butter is bubbly. Serve immediately with remaining garlic butter for dipping and extra lemon wedges.

subcategories.name: Fish
subcategories.desc: Salmon, cod, halibut, sea bass and other fish.

recipes.name: Fish Tacos
ingredients: 600 g (1.3 lbs) white fish — cod, tilapia, or mahi mahi
Toppings: shredded cabbage, pico de gallo, lime crema, avocado, cilantro, lime
recipes.prep: Season fish with cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook fish 3–4 minutes per side until flaky and cooked through. Break into chunks. Warm tortillas. Fill with fish, shredded cabbage, pico de gallo, avocado, and lime crema. Garnish with cilantro and lime.

recipes.name: Grilled Salmon with Mango Salsa
ingredients: Mango salsa: 1 mango diced, ½ red onion diced, 1 jalapeño, juice of 1 lime, cilantro, salt
recipes.prep: Mix all mango salsa ingredients and refrigerate 30 minutes. Brush salmon with olive oil and season with cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Grill over high heat 3–4 minutes per side until cooked through with nice grill marks. Do not move until it releases naturally. Top with mango salsa and serve.

recipes.name: Pan Seared Halibut
ingredients: Capers and cherry tomatoes for garnish
recipes.prep: Pat halibut completely dry. Season generously with salt and white pepper. Heat olive oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Add halibut and cook without moving 4 minutes until a golden crust forms. Flip gently. Add butter, garlic, and thyme. Baste continuously for 2 minutes. Fish should be opaque and flake easily. Add lemon juice. Garnish with capers and burst cherry tomatoes.

recipes.name: Pan Seared Salmon
recipes.prep: Pat salmon completely dry. Score skin lightly. Season generously with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Place salmon skin side down and press gently with a spatula for 30 seconds. Cook without moving 4–5 minutes until skin is deeply crispy and fish is cooked two-thirds up the sides. Flip. Add butter and garlic. Baste for 1 minute. Remove and squeeze lemon over top. Rest 2 minutes.

recipes.name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with foil. Mix olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and zest, dill, parsley, and oregano. Place salmon fillets on prepared baking sheet. Pour herb mixture over salmon. Top each fillet with lemon slices. Season with salt and pepper. Bake 12–15 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork. Do not overbake — salmon should still be slightly pink in the center for best texture.

recipes.name: Miso Glazed Salmon
ingredients: Glaze: 3 tbsp white miso paste, 2 tbsp mirin, 2 tbsp sake or dry sherry, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp sesame oil
Sesame seeds and green onions to garnish
recipes.prep: Whisk glaze ingredients until smooth. Marinate salmon in glaze at least 30 minutes or up to overnight in the refrigerator. Preheat broiler to high. Line a baking sheet with foil and lightly oil it. Place salmon skin side down. Broil 6–8 inches from heat for 8–10 minutes until glaze is caramelized and deep golden and salmon is just cooked through. Watch carefully as the sugar in the miso can burn quickly. Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onions.

recipes.name: Baked Cod with Herb Crust
ingredients: Crust: 1 cup panko breadcrumbs, 3 tbsp Parmesan grated, 2 tbsp fresh parsley, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 garlic cloves minced, 1 tsp lemon zest, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Pat cod dry and place on a greased baking sheet. Brush top of each fillet with Dijon mustard. Mix panko, Parmesan, parsley, olive oil, garlic, lemon zest, salt, and pepper until well combined. Press herb crust firmly onto the mustard-coated top of each fillet. Bake 15–18 minutes until crust is golden and fish flakes easily. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Blackened Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1.5 lbs (680 g) white fish — cod, mahi mahi, or tilapia
Blackening Spice: 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, ½ tsp cayenne, ½ tsp dried thyme, salt
Slaw: 2 cups cabbage shredded, lime juice, cilantro, mayo, salt
Avocado, lime, and salsa to serve
recipes.prep: Mix blackening spice. Coat fish fillets generously on all sides. Heat oil in a cast iron skillet over very high heat until smoking. Cook fish 3 minutes per side until deeply charred and cooked through. Rest 2 minutes and break into large flakes. Mix slaw ingredients. Warm tortillas. Fill each with blackened fish and slaw. Top with avocado slices, salsa, and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Baked Sea Bass
ingredients: 4 sea bass fillets or 2 whole small sea bass
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Place fish in a baking dish. Scatter garlic, cherry tomatoes, and olives around the fish. Pour wine over everything. Drizzle with olive oil. Lay fresh herbs and lemon slices on top. Season generously. Bake 18–22 minutes until fish flakes easily and tomatoes have burst and caramelized. Spoon pan juices over fish to serve.

recipes.name: Tilapia Piccata
recipes.prep: Season tilapia with salt and pepper. Dredge lightly in flour. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook fillets 3 minutes per side until golden. Remove. In same pan add 1 tbsp butter and garlic and cook 1 minute. Add wine and reduce by half. Add broth, lemon juice, and capers. Simmer 3 minutes. Swirl in remaining butter. Return fillets to sauce for 1 minute. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Mahi Mahi with Mango Salsa
ingredients: Mango Salsa: 2 mangos diced, ½ red onion diced, 1 jalapeño diced, ¼ cup cilantro, juice of 2 limes, salt
recipes.prep: Make mango salsa by combining all salsa ingredients. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Season mahi mahi with cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook fish 4 minutes per side until cooked through and golden. Serve topped generously with fresh mango salsa.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Salmon
ingredients: Teriyaki Sauce: 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp mirin, 2 tbsp sake, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp cornstarch dissolved in 1 tbsp water
recipes.prep: Mix sauce ingredients except cornstarch in a small saucepan. Simmer until sugar dissolves. Add cornstarch slurry and stir until slightly thickened. Set aside. Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook salmon skin side up 4 minutes. Flip and cook 3 more minutes. Brush with teriyaki sauce and cook 1 more minute per side until lacquered. Serve over steamed rice. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions.

recipes.name: Fish and Chips
ingredients: 1.5 lbs (680 g) thick cod or haddock fillets
Batter: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 cup cold beer or sparkling water, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt
4 large russet potatoes, cut into thick chips
Malt vinegar, tartar sauce, and lemon to serve
recipes.prep: Fry chips first at 325°F (165°C) for 8 minutes until cooked through but not colored. Drain and set aside. Make batter by whisking flour, beer, baking powder, and salt until smooth — do not overmix. Increase oil to 375°F (190°C). Dredge fish in flour, then dip in batter. Fry 5–6 minutes until deeply golden and crispy. Drain. Re-fry chips at 375°F (190°C) for 3–4 minutes until golden and crispy. Season both immediately with salt. Serve with malt vinegar, tartar sauce, and lemon.

recipes.name: Poached Salmon with Dill Sauce
ingredients: Court Bouillon: 4 cups water, 1 cup white wine, 1 lemon sliced, 1 onion sliced, fresh dill, peppercorns, bay leaf, salt
Dill Sauce: 1 cup sour cream, 2 tbsp fresh dill, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 garlic clove minced, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Combine court bouillon ingredients in a wide pan and simmer 10 minutes. Gently lower salmon fillets into the barely simmering liquid — water should not be boiling. Poach 8–10 minutes until fish is just cooked through and flakes easily. Remove gently with a slotted spatula. Make dill sauce by mixing all ingredients. Serve salmon warm or chilled with dill sauce.

recipes.name: Sole Meunière
ingredients: 4 sole fillets or 2 whole small sole
recipes.prep: Season sole with salt and white pepper. Dredge lightly in flour shaking off excess. Heat 2 tbsp butter and oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until foaming subsides. Cook sole 2 minutes per side — it is very delicate and cooks quickly. Remove to warm plates. Wipe pan clean. Add remaining butter and cook over medium heat until it turns golden brown and smells nutty. Remove from heat immediately and add lemon juice — it will sizzle. Pour brown butter over sole and garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Grilled Swordfish
ingredients: Marinade: 3 tbsp olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt and pepper
Salsa Verde: 1 cup parsley, ¼ cup capers, 2 garlic cloves, 2 anchovy fillets, ½ cup olive oil, 2 tbsp lemon juice, salt
recipes.prep: Marinate swordfish 30 minutes — no longer as acid will start to break down the flesh. Make salsa verde by blending all ingredients. Grill swordfish over high heat 4 minutes per side until cooked through and grill marks appear. Swordfish is done when it flakes but still has a slight translucency in the center. Serve with salsa verde.

recipes.name: Trout Almondine
ingredients: 4 trout fillets or 2 whole trout, butterflied
recipes.prep: Season trout with salt and pepper. Dredge in flour. Heat oil and 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook trout 3–4 minutes per side until golden. Remove and keep warm. In same pan melt remaining butter over medium heat. Add sliced almonds and cook stirring until golden and fragrant — about 3 minutes. Add lemon juice and parsley. Pour almond butter sauce over trout and serve immediately.

recipes.name: New England Fish Chowder
ingredients: 2 lbs (900 g) firm white fish — cod or haddock, cubed
Salt, white pepper, and fresh dill
recipes.prep: Cook bacon until crispy in a large pot. Remove. Cook onion and celery in bacon fat until soft. Add potatoes and enough water or fish broth to cover. Simmer 15 minutes until potatoes are tender. Add milk and cream and bring to a gentle simmer — do not boil. Add fish and cook 8–10 minutes until fish is flaky and cooked through. Season with salt, white pepper, and fresh dill. Serve topped with bacon and oyster crackers.

subcategories.name: Lobster
subcategories.desc: Lobster rolls, thermidor and more.

recipes.name: Boiled Lobster
ingredients: 2 live lobsters, about 700 g (1.5 lbs) each
Clarified butter with garlic and lemon for serving
recipes.prep: Bring a very large pot of heavily salted water to a rolling boil. Submerge lobsters headfirst. Cover and boil 12–14 minutes until shells are bright red and tails are fully curled. Remove and let rest 3 minutes. Crack claws and split tails with kitchen shears. Serve with warm clarified butter mixed with garlic and fresh parsley. Garnish with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Classic Lobster Roll
ingredients: 4 lobster tails, cooked, meat removed and chopped — about 1.5 lbs total
recipes.prep: Mix lobster meat with mayonnaise, celery, lemon juice, and chives. Season with salt and white pepper. Taste — the filling should be lightly dressed not heavy. Butter the outsides of the split-top buns. Toast in a skillet over medium heat until golden on both sides. Line buns with lettuce if desired. Fill generously with lobster mixture. Serve immediately. For a Connecticut-style hot lobster roll omit the mayo and toss warm lobster meat in melted butter instead.

recipes.name: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 2 whole lobsters, cooked and halved lengthwise
½ cup (120 ml) dry white wine
recipes.prep: Remove lobster meat from shells carefully and cut into chunks. Reserve shells. Make sauce: cook shallots and garlic in butter 2 minutes. Add wine and reduce by half. Add cream and simmer until thickened. Add mustard, tarragon, salt, white pepper, and cayenne. Mix lobster chunks with half the sauce. Fill shells with lobster mixture. Spoon remaining sauce over top. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Broil until golden and bubbly — 3–5 minutes.

recipes.name: Lobster Mac and Cheese
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Cook macaroni until al dente. Make cheese sauce: melt butter, whisk in flour 1 minute, gradually add milk and cream until smooth and thickened. Remove from heat and stir in all three cheeses, mustard, salt, white pepper, and cayenne. Combine with pasta and lobster. Pour into a baking dish. Top with buttered panko. Bake 25–30 minutes until golden and bubbly.

recipes.name: Lobster Pasta
ingredients: 2 lobster tails, cooked, meat removed and chopped
½ cup (120 ml) dry white wine
recipes.prep: Cook pasta until al dente. Reserve pasta water. Cook shallots and garlic in butter 2 minutes. Add wine and reduce. Add cream and simmer until thickened. Add lemon juice, cayenne, salt, and white pepper. Add lobster and heat through gently. Toss with pasta adding pasta water as needed. Garnish with fresh tarragon and chives.

recipes.name: Lobster Bisque with Sherry
ingredients: 2 lobster tails — cook meat and reserve shells
Heavy cream drizzle and chives to garnish
recipes.prep: Simmer lobster shells with broth 25 minutes. Strain. Melt butter in a large pot. Cook vegetables until very soft. Add garlic 1 minute. Add tomato paste and paprika 2 minutes. Add sherry and cook until evaporated. Add lobster broth. Simmer 20 minutes. Blend very smooth. Strain through a fine mesh sieve for an ultra-smooth bisque. Return to pot. Add cream and simmer 5 minutes. Season with cayenne, salt, and white pepper. Dice lobster meat and add. Serve with a swirl of cream and fresh chives.

subcategories.name: Mixed
subcategories.desc: Stews, soups and dishes made with several kinds of seafood.

recipes.name: Cioppino
ingredients: Red pepper flakes, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Cook onion until soft. Add garlic and red pepper flakes and cook 1 minute. Add wine and cook 2 minutes. Add tomatoes and broth. Simmer 15 minutes. Add fish and crab and cook 3 minutes. Add clams and mussels and cook covered until they open — about 5 minutes. Add shrimp and cook 2 more minutes. Discard any unopened shellfish. Season and garnish with parsley. Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Clam Bake
ingredients: Melted butter and lemon to serve
recipes.prep: In a very large pot layer potatoes on the bottom. Add onion, sausage, and corn. Add enough water or broth to cover the bottom 2 inches. Season very generously with Old Bay. Bring to a boil and cook covered 15 minutes. Add clams and mussels. Cook 5 minutes. Add shrimp and lobster. Cover and cook 5–8 more minutes until all shellfish are open and shrimp and lobster are cooked. Serve everything from the pot with melted butter and lemon.

recipes.name: Seafood Chowder
ingredients: Salt, white pepper, and fresh chives
recipes.prep: Cook bacon until crispy. Remove. Cook onion and celery in bacon fat until soft. Add flour and stir 2 minutes. Add milk gradually while stirring. Add potatoes and simmer 15 minutes. Add cream and Old Bay. Add fish, shrimp, and scallops. Cook 5–7 minutes until seafood is just cooked. Season with salt and white pepper. Serve topped with bacon and chives.

recipes.name: Seafood Paella
ingredients: 2 cups (400 g) short grain Spanish rice (Bomba)
½ lb (225 g) squid, cut into rings
½ tsp saffron soaked in ¼ cup warm broth
Fresh parsley and lemon to serve
recipes.prep: Heat olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat. Cook onion and pepper until soft. Add garlic and paprika 1 minute. Add diced tomatoes and cook 3 minutes. Add rice and stir to coat 2 minutes. Add warm saffron broth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook uncovered without stirring 15 minutes. Add squid and shrimp on top. Arrange mussels and clams around the pan. Cook 8–10 minutes until rice has absorbed liquid and shellfish have opened. Let rest 5 minutes. Garnish with parsley and lemon.

recipes.name: Portuguese Seafood Stew
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) cod or haddock, cubed
recipes.prep: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Cook onion until soft. Add garlic and paprikas and cook 1 minute. Add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes. Add wine and reduce. Add broth and saffron. Simmer 15 minutes. Add clams and cover 5 minutes until they open. Add fish and shrimp and cook 5 more minutes until just cooked. Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with parsley and cilantro. Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Italian Seafood Soup (Zuppa di Pesce)
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) mixed fish fillets, cubed
½ cup (120 ml) dry white wine
recipes.prep: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Cook onion and garlic until soft. Add red pepper flakes and cook 1 minute. Add wine and reduce. Add crushed tomatoes and broth. Simmer 15 minutes. Add clams and mussels and cover until they open. Add fish and shrimp and cook 5 minutes until just done. Discard any unopened shells. Season with salt. Garnish with parsley and basil. Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Korean Spicy Seafood Soup (Haemul Jeongol)
ingredients: Mixed seafood: shrimp, mussels, clams, squid, white fish — 2 lbs total
4 cups (960 ml) anchovy or seafood broth
recipes.prep: Combine broth, gochujang, soy sauce, gochugaru, garlic, and ginger in a large pot. Bring to a boil. Add firmer vegetables like zucchini first. Add tofu. Add seafood — firm fish first, then shellfish, then shrimp. Cover and cook 5–8 minutes until all seafood is cooked and shells have opened. Add green onions. Drizzle with sesame oil. Serve bubbling in the pot at the table.

recipes.name: Seafood Hot Pot
ingredients: Mixed seafood: shrimp, scallops, mussels, fish fillets, squid — 2 lbs total
6 cups (1.4 L) dashi or seafood broth
recipes.prep: Prepare dipping broth by combining dashi, soy sauce, and mirin in a hot pot or large pot. Bring to a simmer at the table or on the stove. Arrange all seafood and vegetables on platters. Dip and cook items in the simmering broth — cabbage and tofu take longer while seafood and thin items cook in 1–3 minutes. Eat with ponzu dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Spanish Seafood Stew (Zarzuela)
ingredients: ½ lb (225 g) mussels and clams
recipes.prep: Heat olive oil in a cazuela or Dutch oven. Cook onion and garlic until soft. Add paprika, cayenne, and saffron. Add wine and reduce. Add crushed tomatoes and broth. Simmer 15 minutes. Add squid and fish first. Cook 5 minutes. Add shellfish and cover until shells open. Add shrimp and cook 3 more minutes. Stir in ground toasted almonds to thicken sauce. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Seafood Congee
ingredients: 6 cups (1.4 L) seafood or chicken broth
½ lb (225 g) white fish, thinly sliced
Green onions, fresh ginger julienned, cilantro
Fried shallots and sesame seeds to garnish
recipes.prep: Rinse rice. Combine with broth in a large pot. Bring to a boil. Reduce to low heat and simmer uncovered 45–60 minutes stirring occasionally until rice breaks down into a thick creamy porridge. Add more broth if too thick. Add ginger, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Add thinly sliced fish and shrimp and cook gently 3–5 minutes until just cooked. Season with white pepper. Serve topped with green onions, julienned ginger, cilantro, fried shallots, and sesame seeds.

subcategories.name: Mussels
subcategories.desc: Steamed and creamy mussels.

recipes.name: Mussels Mariniere
ingredients: 1.5 kg (3 lbs) fresh mussels, scrubbed and debearded
recipes.prep: Discard any mussels that are open and do not close when tapped. Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Cook shallots until soft. Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Add wine and bring to a boil. Add mussels. Cover tightly and cook over high heat 3–5 minutes shaking pot occasionally until all mussels open. Discard any that remain closed. Add parsley. Season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately in deep bowls with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Mussels in Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 kg (4.4 lbs) mussels, scrubbed and debearded
recipes.prep: Discard any open mussels that do not close when tapped. Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Cook shallots and garlic 2 minutes. Add wine and thyme and bring to a boil. Add mussels and cover. Cook 4–5 minutes until all mussels open. Remove mussels to a bowl. Add cream to the broth and simmer 3 minutes until slightly thickened. Season with salt and pepper. Return mussels to pot and toss. Garnish with parsley. Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Thai Steamed Mussels
ingredients: 2 kg (4.4 lbs) mussels, scrubbed and debearded
½ cup (120 ml) white wine or chicken broth
recipes.prep: Discard any open mussels. In a large pot combine lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, chilies, garlic, and ginger with coconut milk and wine. Bring to a boil. Add mussels. Cover and cook 4–5 minutes until all mussels open. Discard any that remain closed. Add fish sauce and lime juice. Adjust seasoning. Garnish with fresh cilantro and Thai basil.

recipes.name: Mussels with Chorizo
recipes.prep: Cook chorizo in olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat until browned and oil is orange. Remove chorizo. Cook shallots and garlic in same pot 2 minutes. Add wine and reduce. Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes. Return chorizo. Add mussels and cover. Cook 4–5 minutes until all mussels open. Discard any that do not open. Garnish with parsley. Serve with crusty bread.

subcategories.name: Oysters
subcategories.desc: Fried, baked and stewed oysters.

recipes.name: Oysters Rockefeller
ingredients: 24 fresh oysters on the half shell
Topping: 1 cup fresh spinach blanched and squeezed dry, 4 tbsp butter, 4 shallots minced, 2 garlic cloves, ¼ cup Parmesan, ¼ cup breadcrumbs, 2 tbsp Pernod or anise liqueur, salt, cayenne, and pepper
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C). Cook shallots and garlic in butter 2 minutes. Add spinach and cook 1 minute. Add Pernod and cook until evaporated. Mix with Parmesan and breadcrumbs. Season with salt and cayenne. Fill a baking pan with rock salt to hold oysters steady. Nestle oysters in their half shells into the salt. Top each oyster with a generous spoonful of spinach mixture. Bake 10–12 minutes until topping is golden and oysters are just cooked.

recipes.name: Fried Oysters
ingredients: 1 cup panko breadcrumbs seasoned with Old Bay, salt and pepper
Tartar sauce and lemon to serve
recipes.prep: Pat oysters dry. Set up breading station: flour, beaten eggs, and seasoned panko. Coat each oyster in flour, then egg, then panko pressing firmly to adhere. Heat 2 inches of oil to 375°F (190°C). Fry oysters in batches 2–3 minutes until golden and crispy. Do not overcook. Drain on a wire rack. Serve immediately with tartar sauce and lemon.

recipes.name: Oyster Stew
ingredients: 1 pint fresh shucked oysters with their liquor
Fresh parsley and oyster crackers to serve
recipes.prep: Melt butter in a pot over medium heat. Cook onion and celery until very soft — about 10 minutes. Add milk and cream and bring to a very gentle simmer — do not boil. Add oysters with their liquor. Cook gently 5–8 minutes until oysters just begin to curl at the edges and are just cooked through. Season with salt, white pepper, and cayenne. Serve immediately topped with parsley and oyster crackers.

recipes.name: Baked Oysters with Parmesan
ingredients: 24 fresh oysters on the half shell
Topping: 4 tbsp butter softened, 4 garlic cloves minced, ½ cup Parmesan grated, ¼ cup breadcrumbs, 2 tbsp fresh parsley, juice of ½ lemon, cayenne, salt
recipes.prep: Preheat broiler to high. Mix all topping ingredients together until combined. Fill a baking pan with rock salt. Nestle oysters in their shells into the salt so they sit level. Top each oyster with a generous amount of Parmesan topping. Broil 4–5 minutes until topping is golden and bubbly and oysters are just cooked. Serve immediately with lemon wedges.

subcategories.name: Raw
subcategories.desc: Sashimi, poke, tartare, tataki, crudo and ceviche.

recipes.name: Shrimp Ceviche
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
½ red onion, very finely diced
recipes.prep: If using raw shrimp cook briefly in boiling salted water 1–2 minutes until just pink. Cool and chop into ½-inch pieces. If using cooked shrimp chop directly. Combine shrimp with lime and lemon juice. Add cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, and jalapeño. Toss well. Refrigerate 30 minutes to 1 hour — the acid will continue to cure the shrimp. Just before serving stir in cilantro and avocado. Season with salt. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Raw Oysters with Mignonette
ingredients: 24 fresh oysters, freshly shucked on the half shell
Mignonette: 2 shallots very finely minced, ½ cup red wine vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, ½ tsp cracked black pepper
Lemon wedges and Tabasco to serve
recipes.prep: Make mignonette by combining shallots, red wine vinegar, sugar, and cracked black pepper. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes — the shallots will mellow and the flavors meld. Shuck oysters and loosen meat from shells leaving in the shell. Arrange on crushed ice. Serve with mignonette sauce, lemon wedges, and Tabasco. Eat immediately while very cold.

recipes.name: Salmon Sashimi
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) sushi-grade salmon, very fresh
recipes.prep: Purchase only sushi-grade salmon from a reputable fishmonger. Place salmon in the freezer 30 minutes — slightly firm fish is easier to slice. Using a very sharp long knife slice salmon against the grain at a slight diagonal into ¼-inch thick slices. Each slice should be smooth and clean — do not saw. Arrange on a plate with shredded daikon and shiso leaves. Serve immediately with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.

recipes.name: Tuna Poke Bowl
ingredients: Poke Marinade: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sriracha, 1 tsp ginger grated
2 cups cooked sushi rice or brown rice
recipes.prep: Mix poke marinade. Toss tuna cubes with marinade and refrigerate 15–30 minutes. Build bowls with rice base. Arrange marinated tuna, avocado, cucumber, edamame, and mango in sections on top. Drizzle with extra sesame oil and soy sauce. Garnish with sesame seeds, green onions, and furikake if using.

recipes.name: Salmon Poke Bowl
ingredients: Marinade: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp mirin, 1 tsp ginger, 1 tsp sriracha
Toppings: avocado, cucumber, edamame, shredded carrots, radish, pickled ginger
Sesame seeds, furikake, and green onions
recipes.prep: Toss salmon cubes with marinade and refrigerate 15 minutes. Cook rice. Make sriracha mayo by mixing equal parts mayo and sriracha. Build bowls with rice base. Add marinated salmon. Arrange toppings in sections. Drizzle with sriracha mayo. Garnish with sesame seeds, furikake, and green onions.

recipes.name: Fish Tartare
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) sushi-grade tuna or salmon, very finely diced
Toast points or blinis to serve
recipes.prep: All ingredients must be very cold. Dice fish into very small even pieces. Mix with shallots, capers, Dijon, lemon juice, olive oil, and chives. Season carefully with salt, white pepper, and a pinch of cayenne. Taste — the flavor should be clean and bright. Serve immediately on toast points or blinis. Do not prepare more than 30 minutes ahead.

recipes.name: Yellowtail Jalapeño
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) sushi-grade yellowtail, thinly sliced
Ponzu Sauce: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp lime juice, 1 tbsp mirin, 1 tsp sesame oil
Micro cilantro or thin cilantro leaves
Crispy garlic chips or fried shallots
recipes.prep: Mix ponzu sauce. Arrange thin slices of yellowtail on a chilled plate. Place one thin jalapeño slice on each piece of fish. Spoon ponzu sauce over each piece. Garnish with cilantro and crispy garlic chips. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Oyster Shooters
ingredients: Shooter Mix: 8 tbsp vodka, 8 tsp horseradish, 8 tsp ketchup or cocktail sauce, 8 tsp hot sauce, 8 tsp lemon juice
recipes.prep: Shuck oysters and collect their liquor. Mix all shooter liquid ingredients and season with celery salt and black pepper. Pour a small amount of shooter mix into shot glasses. Slide one raw oyster with its liquor into each glass. Serve immediately. The diner should drink the entire contents in one shot.

recipes.name: Salmon Tartare
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) sushi-grade salmon, very finely diced
Cucumber slices or crackers to serve
recipes.prep: Keep all ingredients very cold. Dice salmon very finely. Combine with capers, shallot, dill, crème fraîche, lemon juice, and olive oil. Season with salt and white pepper. Serve immediately using a ring mold for presentation or on cucumber slices and crackers. Do not prepare more than 30 minutes in advance.

recipes.name: Tuna Tataki
ingredients: Ponzu: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp mirin
Sesame seeds, green onions, micro greens, and grated daikon
recipes.prep: Brush tuna loin with sesame oil and season with salt and pepper. Heat a cast iron pan over the highest heat possible until smoking. Sear tuna 30 seconds per side — all four sides. The outside should be seared and the inside completely raw. Immediately plunge into ice water 1 minute to stop cooking. Pat dry. Slice very thin. Arrange on a plate with daikon, green onions, and micro greens. Drizzle with ponzu. Garnish with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Ahi Tuna Poke Nachos
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) sushi-grade ahi tuna, diced
Poke Marinade: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tsp sriracha, 1 tsp ginger
recipes.prep: Toss diced tuna with poke marinade and refrigerate 15 minutes. Make spicy mayo by mixing mayo and sriracha. Arrange wonton or taro chips on a platter. Add a dollop of mashed avocado on each chip. Top with marinated tuna. Drizzle with spicy mayo. Garnish with pickled jalapeños, green onions, and sesame seeds. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Scallop Crudo
ingredients: 12 fresh sea scallops, very fresh, sliced thin
Dressing: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp lemon zest, 1 shallot finely minced, salt and white pepper
Sea salt flakes and cracked black pepper
recipes.prep: Use only the freshest dry scallops available. Slice each scallop crosswise into 3 thin rounds. Arrange on a chilled plate. Mix dressing and drizzle lightly over scallops. Garnish with microgreens and shaved Parmesan or fennel. Finish with a pinch of sea salt flakes and cracked black pepper. Serve immediately — the acid will start curing the scallops if left too long.

subcategories.name: Scallops
subcategories.desc: Seared and pan-roasted scallops.

recipes.name: Seared Scallops
ingredients: Cauliflower puree or pea puree to serve
recipes.prep: Pat scallops completely dry with paper towels. Remove the side muscle. Season generously with salt and white pepper. Heat olive oil in a heavy skillet over very high heat until almost smoking. Add scallops in a single layer — do not crowd. Cook without moving 1.5–2 minutes until a deep golden crust forms. Flip. Add butter, garlic, and thyme. Baste for 1 minute. Scallops should be slightly translucent in the center. Serve immediately with lemon.

subcategories.name: Shrimp
subcategories.desc: Shrimp scampi, tacos, grits and more.

recipes.name: Breaded Fried Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined (tails optional)
recipes.prep: Pat shrimp dry. Set up three bowls: (1) flour mixed with garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper, (2) beaten eggs, (3) breadcrumbs with cayenne if using. Dredge shrimp in flour, dip in egg, then coat in breadcrumbs. Heat oil to 350°F. Fry shrimp in batches 2–3 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. Remove to paper towels, season lightly with salt, and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Baked Stuffed Shrimp
ingredients: 16 jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined, butterflied
Stuffing: 1 cup breadcrumbs, 100 g (3.5 oz) crab meat, 4 tbsp butter melted, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp parsley, juice of ½ lemon, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Mix stuffing ingredients together. Butterfly shrimp by cutting along the back and opening flat. Press a spoonful of stuffing onto each shrimp. Place on a greased baking sheet. Bake 12–15 minutes until shrimp are pink and stuffing is golden. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
ingredients: 500 g (1 lb) large shrimp, peeled and deveined
recipes.prep: Pat shrimp dry. Season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Heat olive oil and 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add shrimp in a single layer. Cook 1–2 minutes until pink on the bottom. Flip. Add garlic and remaining butter. Cook 1 more minute until shrimp are opaque and curled. Add lemon juice and parsley. Toss to coat. Serve immediately over rice or pasta.

recipes.name: Shrimp and Grits
ingredients: Green onions and hot sauce to serve
recipes.prep: Make grits: bring liquid to a boil, whisk in grits, cook stirring frequently 20–25 minutes until thick. Stir in butter and cheddar. Season. Cook bacon until crispy. Remove. Cook mushrooms in bacon fat. Add garlic and shrimp. Cook 2–3 minutes until shrimp are pink. Add lemon juice. Serve shrimp mixture over cheesy grits. Top with bacon and green onions.

recipes.name: Shrimp Tacos
ingredients: Toppings: shredded cabbage, mango salsa, avocado, lime crema, cilantro
recipes.prep: Season shrimp with all spices, salt, and pepper. Heat olive oil in a skillet over high heat. Cook shrimp 1–2 minutes per side until pink and slightly charred. Make lime crema by mixing sour cream, lime juice, and salt. Warm tortillas. Fill with shrimp, shredded cabbage, mango salsa, avocado, and lime crema. Garnish with cilantro and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Shrimp Scampi
ingredients: 1.5 lbs (680 g) large shrimp, peeled and deveined
½ cup (120 ml) dry white wine
¼ cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
recipes.prep: Cook linguine until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water. Heat olive oil and 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season shrimp with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Add shrimp and cook 1–2 minutes per side until pink and just cooked. Remove shrimp. Add garlic to same pan and cook 30 seconds. Add white wine and cook until reduced by half. Add remaining butter, lemon juice, and zest. Return shrimp and toss. Add pasta and pasta water as needed. Toss with parsley.

recipes.name: Coconut Shrimp
ingredients: 1.5 lbs (680 g) large shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails on
Dipping Sauce: ½ cup orange marmalade, 2 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp horseradish
recipes.prep: Set up breading station: seasoned flour, beaten eggs, and coconut mixed with panko. Hold each shrimp by the tail. Coat in flour, then egg, then coconut-panko mixture pressing firmly to adhere. Heat 2 inches of oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry shrimp in batches 2–3 minutes until golden and coconut is toasted. Drain on a wire rack. Mix dipping sauce ingredients. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless chicken thighs, cubed
recipes.prep: Brown sausage in a large Dutch oven. Remove. Brown chicken. Remove. Cook onion, celery, and pepper until soft. Add garlic 1 minute. Add Cajun seasoning and thyme. Return sausage and chicken. Add crushed tomatoes, broth, and rice. Bring to boil. Cover and cook on low heat 20 minutes. Add shrimp on top. Cover and cook 5 more minutes until shrimp are pink and rice is cooked. Fluff and garnish with green onions and parsley.

recipes.name: Shrimp Stir Fry
ingredients: Sauce: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp cornstarch, ½ cup chicken broth
recipes.prep: Mix sauce ingredients. Heat oil in a wok over very high heat. Cook shrimp 1 minute per side until pink. Remove. Add garlic and ginger and cook 30 seconds. Add broccoli and pepper and stir fry 3 minutes. Add snap peas and cook 1 minute. Return shrimp. Pour sauce over and toss until sauce thickens and coats everything — about 1 minute. Serve over steamed rice.

recipes.name: Shrimp Fried Rice
recipes.prep: Heat oil in a wok over very high heat. Cook shrimp 1 minute per side until pink. Remove. Add eggs and scramble. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add cold rice and break up clumps. Stir fry 3 minutes until heated through. Return shrimp. Add peas and carrots, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil. Toss together over high heat. Garnish with green onions.

recipes.name: Cajun Shrimp Pasta
ingredients: Cajun Seasoning: 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp cayenne, ½ tsp thyme, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Cook pasta until al dente. Toss shrimp with Cajun seasoning. Cook in 1 tbsp butter over high heat 1–2 minutes per side. Remove. In same pan melt remaining butter and cook garlic 1 minute. Add cherry tomatoes and cook 2 minutes. Add cream and simmer 3 minutes. Stir in Parmesan. Return shrimp. Toss with drained pasta. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Bang Bang Shrimp
ingredients: Bang Bang Sauce: ½ cup mayonnaise, 3 tbsp sweet chili sauce, 1 tbsp sriracha, 1 tbsp honey
Lettuce leaves, green onions, and sesame seeds to serve
recipes.prep: Mix bang bang sauce and refrigerate. Season shrimp with salt and pepper. Toss with cornstarch until well coated. Fry in batches at 375°F (190°C) for 2–3 minutes until golden and crispy. Drain. Toss immediately with bang bang sauce. Serve on a bed of lettuce leaves garnished with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Shrimp Po Boy
ingredients: Coating: 1 cup flour, 1 cup cornmeal, 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning, salt
Remoulade: ½ cup mayo, 2 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp horseradish, 1 tbsp hot sauce, 1 tbsp capers, 1 tsp smoked paprika
recipes.prep: Soak shrimp in buttermilk 15 minutes. Mix flour, cornmeal, and Cajun seasoning. Dredge shrimp in coating. Fry at 350°F (175°C) for 2–3 minutes until golden. Drain. Mix remoulade. Toast hoagie rolls. Spread remoulade on both sides. Fill with fried shrimp, lettuce, tomato, and pickles. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Shrimp
ingredients: Sauce: 3 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 4 garlic cloves minced, 1 tbsp fresh ginger, 1 tbsp lime juice, 1 tsp sriracha
recipes.prep: Mix sauce ingredients. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add shrimp in a single layer and cook 1 minute per side until pink. Remove shrimp. Add sauce to the pan and simmer 2 minutes until slightly thickened. Return shrimp and toss to coat. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over steamed rice.

recipes.name: Shrimp Étouffée
ingredients: 2 cups (480 ml) shrimp or chicken broth
recipes.prep: Melt butter in a large heavy skillet over medium heat. Add onion, celery, and bell pepper and cook until very soft — about 10 minutes. Add garlic and cook 2 minutes. Sprinkle flour over vegetables and stir 2 minutes. Add broth gradually while stirring. Add Cajun seasoning, salt, cayenne, and pepper. Simmer 10 minutes until sauce thickens. Add shrimp and cook 4–5 minutes until just cooked through. Garnish with green onions and parsley. Serve over white rice.

recipes.name: Tom Yum Goong
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) large shrimp, peeled — reserve shells
4 cups (960 ml) water or light chicken broth
recipes.prep: Simmer shrimp shells in water 15 minutes. Strain and return shrimp broth to pot. Add lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, galangal, and chilies. Simmer 10 minutes to infuse. Add mushrooms and shrimp. Cook 3–4 minutes until shrimp are pink. Season with fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar — the soup should be intensely sour, salty, and spicy. Garnish with cilantro. Discard lemongrass and galangal before serving.

recipes.name: Shrimp and Corn Soup
ingredients: 3 cups corn kernels, fresh or frozen
recipes.prep: Cook onion in butter until soft. Add garlic and paprika 1 minute. Add potatoes and broth. Simmer 15 minutes. Add corn and blend half the soup until creamy. Return to pot. Add cream and bring to a gentle simmer. Add shrimp and cook 3–4 minutes until pink. Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with chives.

subcategories.name: Sushi
subcategories.desc: Sushi rolls and hand rolls.

recipes.name: California Roll
ingredients: 1 cup imitation crab or real crab meat
Soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger to serve
recipes.prep: Place a nori sheet on a bamboo mat shiny side down. With wet hands spread a thin even layer of sushi rice over the nori leaving a ½-inch border at the top. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Flip the nori so the rice side is down on the mat. Place crab, avocado, and cucumber in a line along the edge closest to you. Roll tightly using the mat to guide, pressing firmly as you roll. Seal the edge with a little water. Slice with a wet sharp knife into 8 pieces. Serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.

recipes.name: Spicy Tuna Roll
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) sushi-grade tuna, finely chopped
Spicy Mayo: 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp sriracha, 1 tsp sesame oil
Soy sauce and pickled ginger to serve
recipes.prep: Mix chopped tuna with spicy mayo. Make inside-out rolls: place nori on bamboo mat. Spread rice over nori. Flip so rice is face down. Place spicy tuna mixture and cucumber along the edge. Roll tightly. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Slice with a wet sharp knife. Serve with soy sauce and pickled ginger.

recipes.name: Dragon Roll
ingredients: Unagi sauce: ½ cup soy sauce, ¼ cup mirin, 2 tbsp sugar, reduced by half
recipes.prep: Make shrimp tempura by coating shrimp in tempura batter and frying. Make inside-out rolls with rice on the outside. Fill with shrimp tempura and cucumber. Roll tightly. Fan thin avocado slices over the top of the roll. Wrap in plastic and press gently with the bamboo mat to shape. Remove plastic and slice. Top with tobiko. Drizzle with unagi sauce and spicy mayo.

recipes.name: Homemade Sushi Temaki Hand Rolls
ingredients: Fillings: sushi-grade salmon and tuna diced, cucumber julienned, avocado sliced, cream cheese (optional)
Soy sauce and wasabi to serve
recipes.prep: Lay a half-sheet of nori flat in your hand shiny side down. Place a small scoop of rice on the left side of the nori. Add 2–3 fillings diagonally across the rice. Fold the bottom left corner of the nori over the filling, then continue rolling into a cone shape. The hand roll should be eaten immediately — nori becomes soggy quickly. Serve with soy sauce and wasabi. Set up all fillings in small bowls so guests can make their own.

name: Beef
desc: Classic beef dishes from steaks and roasts to stews, stir fries, and slow-cooked comfort food.

subcategories.name: Classics
subcategories.desc: Classic beef dishes from steaks and roasts to stews and stir fries.

recipes.name: Beef Chili
ingredients: 2 cans (14 oz each) kidney beans, drained
Toppings: sour cream, cheese, green onions
recipes.prep: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Brown ground beef and drain excess fat. Add onion, pepper, and garlic and cook until softened. Add all spices and cook 1 minute. Add crushed tomatoes and beans. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 30–40 minutes until thick. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with toppings.

recipes.name: Beef Kebabs
ingredients: Flatbread, tzatziki, and salad to serve
recipes.prep: Combine ground beef with grated onion, garlic, parsley, and all spices. Mix well. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Shape around flat metal skewers into long sausage shapes, pressing firmly. Grill over high heat or cook in a grill pan, turning occasionally, until cooked through and charred in spots — about 10–12 minutes. Serve with flatbread, tzatziki, and fresh salad.

recipes.name: Beef Rendang
ingredients: Paste: 6 shallots, 4 garlic cloves, 3 red chilies, 2-inch galangal, 2-inch ginger, 2 lemongrass stalks
recipes.prep: Blend paste ingredients until smooth. Heat oil in a large wok or pot. Cook paste over medium heat until fragrant and oil separates, about 10 minutes. Add beef and stir to coat. Add coconut milk, lime leaves, cinnamon, and star anise. Simmer uncovered over medium-low heat stirring occasionally 2–3 hours until liquid is almost completely absorbed and beef is dark and dry-fried. Add toasted coconut in the last 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Beef Short Ribs
ingredients: 1.5 kg (3 lbs) bone-in beef short ribs
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C). Season short ribs generously with salt and pepper. Sear in olive oil in a Dutch oven over high heat on all sides until deeply browned. Remove. Cook vegetables until softened. Add garlic and tomato paste. Add wine and reduce by half. Add broth and herbs. Return ribs bone side up. Cover and braise 3–3.5 hours until meat is falling off the bone. Strain sauce and reduce if desired.

recipes.name: Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 kg (2 lbs) beef chuck, cut into 2-inch cubes
recipes.prep: Season beef with salt and pepper and dust with flour. Brown in olive oil in a large pot over high heat in batches. Remove beef. Cook onion, carrots, and celery until softened. Add garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute. Add wine and reduce. Add broth, herbs, and beef. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 1.5 hours. Add potatoes and cook 30 more minutes until everything is tender.

recipes.name: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 600 g (1.3 lbs) beef sirloin or tenderloin, thinly sliced
Egg noodles or rice to serve
recipes.prep: Season beef strips with salt and pepper. Heat butter in a large skillet over high heat. Cook beef quickly in batches until browned — do not overcook. Remove. Cook mushrooms and onions until golden. Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Add broth and Worcestershire and reduce by half. Lower heat and stir in sour cream and mustard. Return beef and heat through gently. Do not boil after adding sour cream. Serve over egg noodles.

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
ingredients: Toppings: shredded cheese, sour cream, salsa, avocado, cilantro, lime
recipes.prep: Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking up lumps. Drain excess fat. Add onion and cook until softened. Add garlic and all spices and cook 1 minute. Add diced tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until most liquid evaporates. Season with salt and pepper. Warm tortillas. Fill with beef mixture and desired toppings.

recipes.name: Beef Wellington
ingredients: 500 g (1 lb) cremini mushrooms, finely chopped (duxelles)
recipes.prep: Season tenderloin and sear in butter over very high heat on all sides. Cool completely. Brush with Dijon mustard. Make duxelles by cooking mushrooms in butter until all moisture evaporates — about 15 minutes. Cool. Lay prosciutto on plastic wrap, spread duxelles, place beef at edge and roll tightly. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Wrap in puff pastry, seal edges with egg wash. Brush with egg wash. Bake at 425°F 25–30 minutes until pastry is golden and beef reaches 125°F for medium rare. Rest 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Classic Beef Meatloaf
ingredients: Glaze: ½ cup ketchup, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Soak breadcrumbs in milk 5 minutes. Combine ground beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, onion, garlic, Worcestershire, thyme, salt and pepper. Mix gently until just combined — do not overmix. Form into a loaf shape in a baking dish or loaf pan. Mix glaze ingredients and spread over top. Bake 55–65 minutes until internal temperature reaches 160°F. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Classic Pot Roast
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C). Pat beef dry and season generously with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over high heat. Sear beef on all sides until deeply browned, about 3–4 minutes per side. Remove beef. Add onion, carrots, and celery and cook 3 minutes. Add garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute. Add wine and scrape up any browned bits. Add broth and herbs. Return beef. Cover tightly and braise in oven 3–3.5 hours until fork tender. Rest 15 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Korean Beef Bulgogi
ingredients: 600 g (1.3 lbs) beef ribeye or sirloin, very thinly sliced
Marinade: 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp sesame oil, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 Asian pear or ½ cup pear juice, 4 garlic cloves minced, 1 tbsp fresh ginger, 2 green onions sliced, 1 tsp black pepper
Sesame seeds and green onions to garnish
recipes.prep: If possible freeze beef 30 minutes for easier thin slicing. Slice paper thin against the grain. Mix all marinade ingredients together. Combine beef with marinade and mix well. Marinate at least 30 minutes, ideally 2 hours. Cook beef in a very hot skillet or grill pan in batches, not crowding the pan. Cook each batch 1–2 minutes per side until caramelized. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.name: Pan Seared Ribeye Steak
ingredients: Flaky sea salt and black pepper
recipes.prep: Remove steaks from fridge 45 minutes before cooking. Pat completely dry. Season generously with salt and pepper on all sides. Heat oil in a heavy cast iron skillet over very high heat until just smoking. Add steaks and cook without moving 3–4 minutes until deeply browned. Flip and cook 2–3 minutes. Add butter, garlic, and herbs. Tilt pan and baste steaks continuously with foamy butter for 2 minutes. Remove and rest on a rack 8–10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Philly Cheesesteak
ingredients: 600 g (1.3 lbs) ribeye steak, very thinly sliced
200 g (7 oz) provolone or Cheez Whiz
recipes.prep: Freeze steak 30 minutes for easier slicing. Slice paper thin. Cook onions and peppers in butter over medium heat until very soft and slightly caramelized — about 15 minutes. Season. Push to the side or remove. Increase heat to high. Cook beef quickly, seasoning with salt and pepper, breaking into small pieces. Combine with onions and peppers. Top with cheese slices and cover pan briefly until melted. Serve on hoagie rolls.

subcategories.name: Barbecue
subcategories.desc: Smoked and slow-cooked beef barbecue.

recipes.name: Smoked Brisket
ingredients: 3 kg (6.5 lbs) whole beef brisket, flat and point
Dry rub: 3 tbsp coarse salt, 2 tbsp coarse black pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder
recipes.prep: Trim excess fat to ¼ inch. Apply dry rub generously on all sides. Refrigerate uncovered overnight. Bring to room temperature 1 hour before smoking. Smoke fat side up at 225–250°F with oak or hickory wood for 8–12 hours. Spritz with water or apple cider vinegar every 2 hours after the first 3 hours. Wrap in butcher paper at 165°F internal temperature. Continue cooking until 200–205°F. Rest wrapped 1–2 hours in a cooler before slicing against the grain.

recipes.name: Texas Style Beef Ribs
ingredients: 2 racks beef plate ribs, 3 bones each
Dry rub: 3 tbsp coarse salt, 2 tbsp coarse black pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder
recipes.prep: Trim excess fat. Apply dry rub aggressively on all sides. Refrigerate uncovered overnight. Smoke at 275°F with oak wood for 8–10 hours until dark bark forms and internal temperature reaches 200–210°F. The meat should jiggle when shaken. Rest wrapped in butcher paper for at least 1 hour before eating. No BBQ sauce needed — the bark and juices are the sauce.

recipes.name: Santa Maria Tri Tip
ingredients: Dry rub: 2 tbsp coarse salt, 1 tbsp black pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika
Salsa fresca and garlic bread to serve
recipes.prep: Apply dry rub on all sides. Let sit at room temperature 1 hour. Grill over high direct heat 4–5 minutes per side until deeply seared. Move to indirect heat and cook until internal temperature reaches 130–135°F for medium rare — about 20–30 more minutes. Rest 10 minutes. Slice thinly against the grain. Tri-tip has two grain directions — find where they meet in the middle and slice accordingly. Serve with salsa fresca and garlic bread.

name: Poultry
desc: Chicken, duck, turkey and game birds.

subcategories.name: Chicken
subcategories.desc: Roasted, fried, grilled, braised, and baked chicken dishes from around the world.

recipes.name: Crispy Chicken Nuggets
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
recipes.prep: Pat chicken dry. Set up three bowls: (1) flour mixed with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, and pepper, (2) beaten eggs, (3) breadcrumbs with oregano. Dredge chicken in flour, dip in egg, then coat in breadcrumbs. Heat oil to about 350°F. Fry nuggets in batches 4–5 minutes per side until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove to paper towels and serve hot.

recipes.name: BBQ Chicken
ingredients: BBQ sauce: 1 cup ketchup, ¼ cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, salt and pepper
Dry rub: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp brown sugar, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Apply dry rub to chicken. Grill over indirect medium heat 35–40 minutes turning occasionally until mostly cooked through. Brush generously with BBQ sauce. Move to direct heat. Grill 5 minutes per side, brushing more sauce and turning, until caramelized and internal temperature reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken
ingredients: 700 g (1.5 lbs) boneless chicken thighs, cubed
Marinade: 1 cup yogurt, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp chili powder, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp ginger
Sauce: 2 tbsp butter, 1 onion diced, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp ginger, 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes, 1 cup heavy cream, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, salt and sugar
recipes.prep: Marinate chicken at least 2 hours. Grill or broil chicken until charred and cooked through. Make sauce by cooking onion in butter until golden. Add garlic, ginger, and spices. Add tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes. Blend until smooth. Return to pan. Add cream and simmer 10 minutes. Add cooked chicken and simmer 5 more minutes. Garnish with cream and cilantro. Serve with naan or rice.

recipes.name: Chicken Cacciatore
recipes.prep: Season chicken and brown in olive oil on all sides. Remove. Cook onion, pepper, and mushrooms until softened. Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Add wine and reduce by half. Add crushed tomatoes and herbs. Return chicken. Simmer covered 40–45 minutes until chicken is very tender. Stir in capers and olives if using. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Chicken Cordon Bleu
recipes.prep: Pound chicken breasts thin. Season with salt and pepper. Place a slice of ham and Swiss cheese on each breast. Roll up tightly and secure with toothpicks. Dredge in flour, dip in egg, coat in breadcrumbs mixed with paprika. Drizzle with melted butter. Bake at 375°F for 30–35 minutes until golden and cooked through. Make a simple cream sauce with butter, garlic, cream, and Dijon mustard. Serve over chicken.

recipes.name: Chicken Marsala
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, pounded thin
recipes.prep: Season chicken with salt and pepper and dredge in flour. Heat olive oil and 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 3–4 minutes per side until golden. Remove. Add mushrooms and cook until golden. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add Marsala and cook until reduced by half. Add broth and simmer 3 minutes. Stir in remaining butter. Return chicken and heat through. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan
recipes.prep: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness. Season with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning. Dredge in flour, dip in egg, then coat in breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan. Pan fry in olive oil over medium-high heat until golden on both sides, about 3–4 minutes per side. Transfer to a baking dish. Top each piece with marinara and mozzarella. Bake at 400°F for 15–20 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.

recipes.name: Chicken Piccata
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, pounded thin
½ cup (120 ml) dry white wine
recipes.prep: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Dredge in flour. Heat olive oil and 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 3–4 minutes per side until golden. Remove. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add wine and cook until reduced by half. Add broth and lemon juice and simmer 3 minutes. Stir in capers and remaining butter until sauce is silky. Return chicken to pan and heat through. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma
ingredients: Marinade: 4 tbsp olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, 4 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp paprika, ½ tsp cinnamon, ½ tsp cayenne, salt and pepper
Pita bread, hummus, tzatziki, pickles, and salad to serve
recipes.prep: Mix marinade ingredients. Coat chicken thoroughly. Marinate at least 2 hours or overnight. Grill or cook in a cast iron skillet over high heat 4–5 minutes per side until charred and cooked through. Rest 5 minutes and slice thinly. Serve in warmed pita with hummus, tzatziki, pickles, and fresh vegetables.

recipes.name: Chicken Souvlaki
ingredients: 700 g (1.5 lbs) boneless chicken breast, cubed
Marinade: 4 tbsp olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp cumin, salt and pepper
Pita, tzatziki, red onion, tomatoes, and cucumber to serve
recipes.prep: Mix marinade and coat chicken thoroughly. Marinate at least 1 hour. Thread onto skewers. Grill over high heat turning occasionally until chicken is cooked through and nicely charred — about 10–12 minutes. Serve in warm pita with tzatziki, sliced red onion, tomatoes, and cucumber.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 700 g (1.5 lbs) boneless chicken breast, cubed
Marinade: 1 cup yogurt, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp ginger
Sauce: 2 tbsp butter, 1 onion, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp ginger, 1 can crushed tomatoes, 1 cup heavy cream, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, paprika, salt
recipes.prep: Marinate chicken 2 hours. Grill or broil until lightly charred. Make sauce: cook onion in butter until golden. Add garlic, ginger, and spices. Add tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes. Blend until smooth. Add cream and simmer 10 minutes. Add chicken and simmer 5 minutes. Serve with basmati rice and naan.

recipes.name: Coq au Vin
recipes.prep: Brown bacon in a Dutch oven. Remove. Brown chicken pieces in bacon fat on all sides. Remove. Cook pearl onions and mushrooms until golden. Add garlic and tomato paste. Add wine, broth, and bouquet garni. Return chicken and bacon. Braise covered at 325°F for 1.5 hours until chicken is very tender. Remove chicken. Strain and reduce sauce. Return chicken and mushrooms to sauce. Serve with crusty bread or mashed potatoes.

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Chicken
ingredients: Sauce: 4 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 4 garlic cloves minced, 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, red pepper flakes
Sesame seeds and green onions to garnish
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Season chicken with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken skin side down 4–5 minutes until golden and crispy. Flip. Mix sauce ingredients and pour over chicken. Transfer to oven and bake 25–30 minutes until cooked through, basting with sauce halfway through. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions.

recipes.name: Lemon Herb Roasted Chicken Thighs
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Mix lemon juice, zest, garlic, olive oil, and all herbs and spices together. Score chicken thighs and coat thoroughly in marinade. Marinate 30 minutes if time allows. Place skin side up in a baking dish. Roast 35–40 minutes until skin is deeply golden and crispy and juices run clear. Baste with pan juices halfway through. Garnish with fresh parsley.

recipes.name: Roast Chicken
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat chicken dry inside and out. Mix butter with garlic, thyme, rosemary, salt and pepper. Carefully separate skin from breast and rub butter mixture directly under the skin. Season the entire outside generously with salt and pepper. Stuff cavity with lemon halves, onion, and remaining herbs. Tie legs together. Place on a rack in a roasting pan. Roast 60–75 minutes until juices run clear and internal temperature reaches 165°F. Rest 15 minutes before carving.

recipes.name: Southern Fried Chicken
recipes.prep: Soak chicken in buttermilk with salt and pepper for at least 4 hours or overnight. Mix flour with all spices, salt, and pepper. Remove chicken from buttermilk and dredge in seasoned flour, pressing to adhere. Let sit on a rack 15 minutes. Heat oil to 325°F in a large heavy pot. Fry chicken in batches — dark meat 13–15 minutes, white meat 10–12 minutes, turning once, until golden brown and cooked through. Drain on a rack.

subcategories.name: Duck
subcategories.desc: Roasted, braised, confit and fried duck.

recipes.name: Braised Duck Legs
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C). Score duck skin. Season and sear skin side down in a Dutch oven over medium heat until fat renders and skin is golden — about 10 minutes. Flip and sear 2 minutes. Remove. Cook vegetables in rendered fat until softened. Add garlic and wine and reduce. Add broth, tomatoes, and herbs. Return duck legs skin side up. Braise uncovered 1.5–2 hours until very tender.

recipes.name: Duck à l'Orange
ingredients: Orange sauce: juice of 4 oranges, zest of 1 orange, 2 tbsp Grand Marnier, 1 cup chicken broth, 2 tbsp butter, 1 tbsp honey, salt and pepper
Salt and black pepper for seasoning
recipes.prep: Score duck skin. Season inside and out with salt and pepper. Roast at 425°F 30 minutes. Drain fat. Reduce to 350°F and roast 60 more minutes until cooked through. Make sauce: cook orange juice with zest and Grand Marnier until reduced by half. Add broth and reduce again. Whisk in cold butter and honey. Season. Carve duck and serve with orange sauce.

recipes.name: Duck Breast with Orange Sauce
ingredients: Sauce: juice of 3 oranges, zest of 1 orange, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 cup (240 ml) chicken broth, 2 tbsp butter, 1 shallot minced
recipes.prep: Score duck skin in a crosshatch pattern without cutting into flesh. Season generously with salt and pepper. Place skin side down in a cold skillet. Turn heat to medium. Cook 12–15 minutes until most fat is rendered and skin is deeply golden and crispy. Flip and cook 3–5 minutes more for medium rare. Rest 5 minutes. Make sauce by cooking shallot in same pan. Add orange juice and zest, honey, and soy sauce. Reduce by half. Add broth and reduce again. Finish with butter.

recipes.name: Duck Confit
ingredients: 1 kg (2 lbs) duck fat or enough to submerge
recipes.prep: Rub duck legs with salt, pepper, garlic, and thyme. Refrigerate uncovered 24 hours. Rinse and pat dry. Preheat oven to 225°F (107°C). Place duck in a deep baking dish and cover completely with melted duck fat. Add herbs and juniper berries. Cover tightly and cook 6–8 hours until meat is very tender and nearly falling off the bone. Cool in fat and store up to 2 weeks. To serve, sear skin side down in a dry hot skillet until deeply golden and crispy.

recipes.name: Duck Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups shredded duck confit or roast duck
recipes.prep: Heat oil in a wok over very high heat. Add eggs and scramble. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add cold rice and stir fry 3 minutes. Add duck, peas, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil. Toss everything together until heated through. Add green onions. Drizzle with sesame oil. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Duck Ragu
recipes.prep: Season duck legs and sear in a Dutch oven over high heat until browned on all sides. Remove. Cook vegetables until softened. Add garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute. Add wine and reduce. Add tomatoes and herbs. Return duck. Braise covered at 325°F for 2–2.5 hours until meat falls off the bone. Shred duck meat and discard bones. Reduce sauce if needed. Toss with pappardelle and Parmesan.

recipes.name: Duck Tacos
ingredients: Duck confit from 4 legs, shredded and crisped
Toppings: pickled red onion, mango salsa, avocado, cilantro, lime crema, jalapeño
recipes.prep: Shred duck confit meat. Crisp in a hot dry skillet until golden and slightly caramelized. Warm tortillas on a dry skillet. Fill with crispy duck meat. Top with pickled red onion, mango salsa, sliced avocado, fresh cilantro, and lime crema. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.name: Peking Duck
ingredients: Chinese pancakes, hoisin sauce, cucumber, and green onions to serve
recipes.prep: Blanch duck with boiling water poured over skin to tighten it. Pat completely dry. Mix maltose, soy sauce, and five spice. Brush all over duck. Air dry on a rack in the refrigerator uncovered 24–48 hours. Preheat oven to 375°F. Roast on a rack 60–75 minutes until skin is deep brown and extremely crispy. Slice off skin and meat thinly. Serve with pancakes, hoisin sauce, cucumber strips, and green onions.

recipes.name: Roasted Duck
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Score duck skin all over in a crosshatch pattern without cutting into flesh. Rub all over with five spice, salt, and pepper inside and out. Stuff cavity with garlic, orange, and herbs. Place on a rack in a roasting pan. Roast at high heat 30 minutes. Drain fat. Reduce to 350°F. Mix orange juice and honey and brush over duck. Roast another 60–75 minutes basting every 20 minutes until skin is deep mahogany and crispy. Rest 15 minutes before carving.

recipes.name: Smoked Duck Salad
ingredients: 1 cup sliced fresh figs or pears
½ cup blue cheese or gorgonzola, crumbled
Dressing: 3 tbsp walnut oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp honey, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Slice smoked duck breast thinly. Arrange salad greens on plates. Top with sliced duck, figs or pears, candied walnuts, and blue cheese. Whisk dressing ingredients together and drizzle over salad. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Wild Duck with Cherry Sauce
ingredients: Cherry sauce: 1 cup fresh or frozen cherries, ½ cup red wine, 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 1 shallot minced, 1 tbsp butter, 1 tsp sugar, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Score duck skin. Season with salt and pepper. Cook skin side down in a cold pan over medium heat 10–12 minutes until fat renders and skin is very crispy. Flip and cook 3 minutes for medium rare. Rest 5 minutes. Make cherry sauce by cooking shallot in butter. Add wine and balsamic and reduce. Add cherries and sugar. Simmer 10 minutes until slightly thickened. Season. Slice duck and serve with cherry sauce.

subcategories.name: Game Birds
