subcategories.desc: Quail, pheasant and guinea fowl.

recipes.name: Grilled Quail
ingredients: Marinade: 4 tbsp olive oil, 3 garlic cloves, juice of 1 lemon, 1 tsp thyme, 1 tsp rosemary, salt and pepper
Salad greens and pan juices to serve
recipes.prep: Mix marinade and coat quails thoroughly. Marinate at least 1 hour. Grill over medium-high heat 4–5 minutes per side until cooked through — juices should run clear. Quail cooks quickly so watch carefully. Rest 5 minutes. Serve on a bed of salad greens drizzled with pan juices and lemon.

recipes.name: Guinea Fowl with Mushrooms
ingredients: ½ cup (120 ml) dry white wine
recipes.prep: Season guinea fowl and brown in butter on all sides. Remove. Cook mushrooms and onion in same pan until golden. Add garlic and thyme. Add wine and reduce by half. Add broth. Return guinea fowl. Cover and simmer 40–45 minutes until cooked through. Remove bird. Add cream to sauce and reduce until slightly thickened. Return bird to sauce. Serve with mashed potatoes or buttered noodles.

recipes.name: Pan Roasted Quail with Grapes
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Season quails inside and out with salt and pepper. Sear in butter in an oven-safe skillet on all sides until golden. Remove. Add shallots, garlic, and grapes and cook 2 minutes. Add Marsala and cook 1 minute. Add broth and thyme. Return quails. Roast in oven 12–15 minutes until cooked through. Remove birds. Reduce sauce until slightly thickened. Serve quails with grapes and sauce.

recipes.name: Roasted Pheasant
ingredients: ½ cup (120 ml) dry white wine
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Mix butter with garlic, thyme, salt and pepper. Rub under skin and all over outside. Cover breast with bacon strips secured with toothpicks to prevent drying. Place on a rack. Pour broth and wine into pan. Roast 50–60 minutes basting frequently until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove bacon for last 10 minutes to brown breast. Rest 10 minutes. Carve and serve with pan juices.

subcategories.name: Turkey
subcategories.desc: Whole roasted turkey, turkey breast, turkey burgers, ground turkey dishes, and holiday classics.

recipes.name: Ground Turkey Tacos
ingredients: Toppings: cheese, sour cream, salsa, lettuce, avocado
recipes.prep: Brown turkey in a skillet. Add onion and garlic and cook until softened. Add all spices and cook 1 minute. Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Serve in taco shells with desired toppings.

recipes.name: Roast Turkey
ingredients: ½ cup (115 g) unsalted butter, softened
4 cups (960 ml) turkey or chicken broth
recipes.prep: The night before, rub turkey all over with salt and refrigerate uncovered. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Mix butter with garlic and fresh herbs. Loosen skin and rub butter under skin over breast and thighs. Rub outside with remaining butter. Season with pepper. Stuff cavity with onion and lemon. Place on a rack in a large roasting pan. Pour 2 cups broth into pan. Roast at high heat 30 minutes. Reduce to 325°F. Roast about 2.5–3 hours total, basting every 30 minutes and adding broth as needed. Internal temperature should reach 165°F at the thigh. Rest 30 minutes before carving.

recipes.name: Turkey Breast Roast
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Mix butter with garlic and herbs. Loosen skin and rub butter under skin and all over outside. Season generously with salt and pepper. Place on a rack in a roasting pan with broth below. Roast 60–80 minutes basting every 20 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Rest 15 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Turkey Burgers
recipes.prep: Mix all ingredients gently — do not overwork. Shape into 4 patties. Make a small indent in the center of each to prevent puffing. Season outside with salt and pepper. Grill or cook in a skillet over medium heat 5–6 minutes per side until cooked through to 165°F. Do not press down. Rest 3 minutes. Serve on buns with desired toppings.

recipes.name: Turkey Kebabs
ingredients: Marinade: 3 tbsp olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, ½ tsp oregano, salt and pepper
Bell peppers and onion, cubed for skewers
recipes.prep: Mix marinade and coat turkey. Marinate 1 hour. Thread turkey, peppers, and onion alternately onto skewers. Grill over medium-high heat turning occasionally until turkey is cooked through and vegetables are slightly charred — about 12–15 minutes. Serve with tzatziki and pita or rice.

recipes.name: Turkey Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 can (8 oz) water chestnuts, drained and chopped
Green onions and sesame seeds to garnish
recipes.prep: Cook turkey in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned. Add onion, garlic, and ginger and cook 3 minutes. Add water chestnuts. Mix soy sauce, hoisin, sesame oil, and vinegar and pour over. Cook 2 minutes. Serve in crisp butter lettuce cups topped with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Turkey Meatballs
recipes.prep: Soak breadcrumbs in milk 5 minutes. Combine turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic, Parmesan, parsley, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper. Mix gently. Roll into golf ball sized balls. Bake on a greased baking sheet at 400°F for 18–20 minutes or pan fry in olive oil until golden on all sides. Simmer in marinara sauce 10 minutes. Serve over pasta or as a sub.

recipes.name: Turkey Meatloaf
ingredients: Glaze: ½ cup ketchup, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp Dijon
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Soak breadcrumbs in milk. Mix turkey with all ingredients gently. Form into a loaf in a baking dish. Mix glaze and spread over top. Bake 55–60 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Turkey Piccata
ingredients: ½ cup (120 ml) dry white wine
recipes.prep: Season turkey with salt and pepper. Dredge in flour. Heat olive oil and 2 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook turkey 3 minutes per side until golden. Remove. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add wine and reduce by half. Add broth and lemon juice and simmer 3 minutes. Stir in capers and remaining butter. Return turkey and heat through. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Turkey Pot Pie
ingredients: 2 sheets pie crust or puff pastry
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Melt butter and cook onion until soft. Whisk in flour and cook 1 minute. Gradually add broth and cream. Stir until thickened. Add turkey, peas, carrots, celery, thyme, salt, and pepper. Line a pie dish with one crust. Fill with turkey mixture. Top with second crust, seal edges, and cut slits. Brush with egg wash. Bake 35–40 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Turkey Soup
ingredients: 8 cups (1.9 L) turkey or chicken broth
recipes.prep: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Cook onion, carrots, and celery until softened. Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Add broth, thyme, and bay leaf. Bring to a boil. Add noodles and cook until tender. Add shredded turkey and heat through. Season with salt and pepper. Remove bay leaf and garnish with fresh parsley.

recipes.name: Turkey Stir Fry
ingredients: 500 g (1 lb) turkey breast, thinly sliced
Sauce: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tsp cornstarch, 1 tsp sugar
recipes.prep: Mix sauce ingredients. Heat oil in a wok over very high heat. Cook turkey quickly in batches until cooked through. Remove. Add vegetables and stir fry 3–4 minutes until tender-crisp. Add garlic and ginger and cook 30 seconds. Return turkey. Pour sauce over and toss until thickened and glossy. Serve over steamed rice.

recipes.name: Turkey Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 4 large bell peppers, tops cut off and seeded
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Cook turkey with onion and garlic. Add tomatoes, cooked rice, and Italian seasoning. Season with salt and pepper. Fill peppers with turkey mixture. Place in a baking dish with ¼ cup water in the bottom. Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes. Uncover, top with mozzarella, and bake 15 more minutes until cheese is melted and peppers are tender.

recipes.name: Turkey Stuffed with Cornbread Dressing
ingredients: Cornbread dressing: 4 cups cornbread crumbled, 1 onion diced, 3 celery stalks diced, 2 eggs, 2 cups chicken broth, 1 tsp sage, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Make dressing by combining cornbread, cooked onion and celery, eggs, broth, sage, salt, and pepper — mixture should be moist but not wet. Preheat oven to 325°F. Rub turkey inside and out with butter, salt, and pepper. Loosely stuff with dressing. Tie legs. Roast 3–3.5 hours until internal temperature in thigh reaches 165°F and stuffing reaches 165°F. Rest 20 minutes. Carve and serve with remaining dressing baked separately.
